title: 第一卷·第二章

segments.original: Now (to forebare for ever solittle of Iris Trees and Lili O'Rangans), concerning the genesis of Harold or Humphrey Chimpden's occupational agnomen (we are back in the presurnames prodromarith period, of course just when enos chalked halltraps) and discarding once for all those theories from older sources which would link him back with such pivotal ancestors as the Glues, the Gravys, the Northeasts, the Ankers and the Earwickers of Sidlesham in the Hundred of Manhood or proclaim him offsprout of vikings who had founded wapentake and seddled hem in Herrick or Eric, the best authenticated version, the Dumlat, read the Reading of Hofed-ben-Edar, has it that it was this way. We are told how in the beginning it came to pass that like cabbaging Cincinnatus the grand old gardener was saving daylight under his redwoodtree one sultry sabbath afternoon, Hag Chivychas Eve, in prefall paradise peace by following his plough for rootles in the rere garden of mobhouse, ye olde marine hotel, when royalty was announced by runner to have been pleased to have halted itself on the highroad along which a leisureloving dogfox had cast followed, also at walking pace, by a lady pack of cocker spaniels. Forgetful of all save his vassal's plain fealty to the ethnarch Humphrey or Harold stayed not to yoke or saddle but stumbled out hotface as he was (his sweatful bandanna loose from his pocketcoat) hasting to the forecourts of his public in topee, surcingle, solascarf and plaid, plus fours, puttees and bulldog boots ruddled cinnabar with flagrant marl, jingling his turnpike keys and bearing aloft amid the fixed pikes of the hunting party a high perch atop of which a flowerpot was fixed earthside hoist with care. On his majesty, who was, or often feigned to be, noticeably longsighted from green youth and had been meaning to inquire what, in effect, had caused yon causeway to be thus potholed, asking substitutionally to be put wise as to whether paternoster and silver doctors were not now more fancied bait for lobstertrapping honest blunt Haromphreyld answered in no uncertain tones very similarly with a fearless forehead: Naw, yer maggers, aw war jist a cotchin on thon bluggy earwuggers. Our sailor king, who was draining a gugglet of obvious adamale, gift both and gorban, upon this, ceasing to swallow, smiled most heartily beneath his walrus moustaches and indulging that none too genial humour which William the Conk on the spindle side had inherited with the hereditary whitelock and some shortfingeredness from his greataunt Sophy, turned towards two of his retinue of gallowglasses, Michael, etheling lord of Leix and Offaly and the jubilee mayor of Drogheda, Elcock, (the two scatterguns being Michael M. Manning, protosyndic of Waterford and an Italian excellency named Giubilei according to a later version cited by the learned scholarch Canavan of Canmakenoise), in either case a triptychal religious family symbolising puritas of doctrina, business per usuals and the purchypatch of hamlock where the paddish preties grow and remarked dilsydulsily: Holybones of Saint Hubert how our red brother of Pouringrainia would audibly fume did he know that we have for surtrusty bailiwick a turnpiker who is by turns a pikebailer no seldomer than an earwigger! For he kinned Jom Pill with his court so gray and his haunts in his house in the mourning. (One still hears that pebble crusted laughta, japijap cheerycherrily, among the roadside tree the lady Holmpatrick planted and still one feels the amossive silence of the cladstone allegibelling: Ive mies outside Bourn.)
segments.draft: 如今（且为鸢尾木与百合猩暂敛言语），论及哈罗德或汉弗莱·钦普登职业副名之渊源（我等此时已溯回无姓氏的前驱结绳纪，恰值以挪士以白垩在厅堂暗井画道记历），且一举摒除旧典诸般附会——即妄图将其攀连于胶合氏、肉汁氏、东北氏、泊锚氏乃至人道百户区西德尔舍姆埃尔威克诸显祖，抑或断言其系开辟兵械检阅区、安家赫里克或埃里克封邑的维京海盗苗裔；考据最确之本，即倒读《塔木德》之《本埃达尔霍斯角录》，所载实乃如斯光景。人道太初创世之际，一如种白菜的辛辛纳图斯，这位老园丁正于大红木下惜取天光。时值某酷热安息日午后，恰逢住棚围猎前夕，正享堕落前乐园宁谧，他在乌合之舍兼老水兵客栈后园扶犁掘薯，忽有信使飞报：御驾驾临，正于公道驻跸。沿途正有一只闲逸雄狐带路徐行，身后一群母可卡犬信步紧随。汉弗莱或哈罗德唯念臣仆对君长之纯朴忠悃，未暇套轭备鞍，满面赤热奔突而出（汗渍头巾从外套衣袋晃荡垂挂），顶着遮阳盔，束着肚带，围着防暑巾，披着格子呢，蹬着灯笼裤、绑腿与厚底牛头犬重靴，刺目红泥染透周身，如涂朱砂，一路摇响收费闸门钥匙，直奔公馆前坪；在狩猎扈从林立的长矛之间，高高擎起一根长杆，顶端倒扣着一只装泥花盆，严加绑缚，谨防倾坠。国王陛下自少壮起即显远视之疾（或常佯作远视），本欲盘问眼前大路何以坑洼遍布，却借题探问：主祷文多钩线与银色飞蝇，如今是否成了更称心的捕虾钓饵？老实耿直之哈伦弗雷德毫无惧色，抬起坦荡前额，语调朗朗，直截应道：“回禀皇上，俺方才不过是在逮那该死的耳夹子地蚕呢。”我等水手老王正仰脖痛饮一长颈陶壶清水，权当贡礼与奉献之物，闻言立止吞咽，海象浓髭下爆出由衷欢笑；顺带施展母系一脉从太姑母索菲亚处遗传之白发、短指与微刻薄谐谑，转向身后两名持斧重甲侍从——莱克斯与奥法利两邑领主麦克尔，以及德罗赫达的禧年市长埃尔科克（依喧噪古寺硕学卡纳万所引后世版本，双枪护从实为沃特福德首席执政官迈克尔·曼宁与意大利贵胄朱比莱伊阁下），无论何版，均成三联宗教家族，象征教义纯正、照常营生与遍植爱尔兰土豆的毒芹庄田；老王轻佻打趣道：“凭圣休伯特圣骨起誓，我等那满面通红的暴雨国弟兄若知我等股肱封邑之内，竟有一位关卡守门人，其执矛卫道之勤，丝毫不逊于捕拿地蚕，定当气得直冒粗烟！”盖因他深知约翰·皮尔与那阴森法庭，深知其宅邸在服丧清晨之鬼影游荡。（人们至今依稀可闻那碎石摩擦般欢笑，叽叽喳喳，欢畅跃动于霍姆帕特里克夫人手植道旁林木之间；至今仍能感应覆衣碑石苔痕深重之肃穆，仿佛无声宣告：距边界尚有五里。）
segments.translation:
且说（鸢尾树与莉莉·奥兰甘暂且少叙），哈罗德或汉弗莱·钦普登那职业别号从何而来？（这就回到未有姓氏的先驱算数期，当然，恰是以挪士用粉笔在门厅画陷阱的时候。）旧书有些说法，把他上溯到胶氏、肉汁氏、东北氏、锚氏这些要紧先祖，还有男子汉百户区西德尔舍姆的厄威克家；也有说他是维京人的后芽，维京人划了瓦彭泰克，便在赫里克或埃里克住下。这些说法一概撇开。证据最确的一本，叫《杜姆拉特》，也就是《霍费德·本·埃达尔读本》，说事情是这样。

据说太初之际，有个闷热的安息日下午，哈格·奇维查斯前夕，那位老园丁像种卷心菜的辛辛纳图斯，趁红杉底下还有天光，安享坠落前的乐园太平。他在那座聚众屋兼老海滨旅店的后园跟着犁寻根块，忽有跑腿来报，御驾高兴在大路上停了。那条路上，一只爱闲逛的公狐已从那里经过，后面一队雌可卡猎犬也踱着步追过去。汉弗莱或哈罗德别的全忘了，只记得臣仆该向君长尽忠。他顾不上套轭备鞍，脸还热着便踉跄跑出（汗湿的头巾松松挂出外衣口袋），直赶往自家酒馆的前院。他顶遮阳盔，束围带，系日光巾，披格纹呢，套过膝短裤、绑腿和牛头犬靴，明晃晃的泥灰把靴染得朱砂红。一串路闸钥匙摇得叮当响；猎队的长矛立定不动，他在当中高擎一根长杆，杆头小心固定着一只花盆，土面朝上举着。

陛下打少年时起便显得眼看得远，兴许常有意装成这样。本想问那条堤道怎会坑坑洼洼，却改口打听，如今捉龙虾，是不是更时兴用「主祷绳」和「银医生」作饵。直肠子的哈龙弗雷尔德也照样不含糊，前额无惧，开口便道：「不哩，陛下，俺只逮那遭瘟的蠼螋哩。」咱的水手王正饮尽一罐显见是亚当麦酒的东西，既是馈赠，又是供献。一听便停了口，海象胡须底下笑得好不痛快。这股不大和气的诙谐连同家传的一绺白发、几分短指，都是大鼻威廉从母系太姑母索菲那里继承来的。国王便拿这股诙谐，转向扈从里的两位盖洛格拉斯武士，莱克斯与奥法利的贵胄领主迈克尔，以及德罗赫达禧年市长埃尔科克。（卡恩马肯诺伊斯的博学学官卡纳万引另一晚本，说这两位持散弹枪的是沃特福德首席市政官迈克尔·M·曼宁和一位叫朱比莱伊的意大利阁下。）无论哪一说，都是一幅三联宗教家族像，象征教义清纯、照常买卖，以及毒芹购地上一畦帕迪小薯。他逗着腔说：「圣休伯特的圣骨哟！咱那暴雨尼亚的红兄弟，要是知道这块最可信赖的辖地上，有位路闸人，轮到他揽长矛的次数竟不比捉蠼螋少，该气出多响的烟呀！」因为他识得乔姆·皮尔，识得那灰庭院，还识得他在服丧时常去的屋里各处。（至今还能在霍姆帕特里克夫人栽下的道旁树间听见那裹碎石的笑，叽啪叽啪，欢欢喜喜；还能感到那披苔石碑的厚重寂静，上头标着模糊的字：离界呜里。）

notes.lemma: concerning the genesis of Harold or Humphrey Chimpden's occupational agnomen (we are back in the presurnames prodromarith period, of course just when enos chalked halltraps)
notes.text: Iris Trees 字面作鸢尾树，或兼涉英国女诗人 Iris Tree；Lili O'Rangans 似拼合百合（lily）、红毛猩猩（orangutan）与奥兰治党人（Orangemen）。agnomen 指古罗马人第四名号（副名）。prodromarith 似拼合前驱（prodrome）与算术（arithmetic），指姓氏确立前的先驱数算期。enos chalked halltraps 字面作以挪士在门厅用粉笔画下落夹，enos 或联想《创世记》4:26 塞特之子以挪士（Enos）或以诺（Enoch）。以上双关与典故均为本项目依词形提出的推测。

notes.text: 西德尔舍姆与男子汉百户区先按两个地名译；wapentake 暂留地制用语的音形。姓氏杂入胶、肉汁、东北、锚等日常词。叙述在开头便撇开两条祖系传闻。现有出处可核原句。行政沿革与人名对应仍待核。

notes.text: Dumlat 倒读是 Talmud，正文留倒置书名。西塞罗《论老年》§56 说，据传辛辛纳图斯在犁边获知任命。乔伊斯让园丁扶犁而有人报驾，并添种卷心菜的 cabbaging。Hofed-ben-Edar 仍留拟音；Hag Chivychas Eve 的节期指向待考。

notes.text: 两处 pike 先在路闸钥匙和猎队长矛里出现。杆顶缚花盆，earthside hoist 暂按土面朝上译，花盆用法待证。答话的 earwuggers 音近 Earwicker，并接国王后面的 turnpiker／pikebailer／earwigger。译文保三种动作，难以合响。

notes.text: which 回指 humour。从索菲一处承来的有三样：诙谐、一绺白发和几分短指；on the spindle side 暂取母系。大鼻威廉是依 Conk 所作双关译名。征服者威廉、水手王的历史身份与暴雨尼亚的国名所指仍待证。

segments.original: Comes the question are these the facts of his nominigentilisation as recorded and accolated in both or either of the collateral andrewpaulmurphyc narratives. Are those their fata which we read in sibylline between the fas and its nefas? No dung on the road? And shall Nohomiah be our place like? Yea, Mulachy our kingable khan? We shall perhaps not so soon see. Pinck poncks that bail for seeks alicence where cumsceptres with scentaurs stay. Bear in mind, son of Hokmah, if so be you have metheg in your midness, this man is mountain and unto changeth doth one ascend. Heave we aside the fallacy, as punical as finikin, that it was not the king kingself but his inseparable sisters, uncontrollable nighttalkers, Skertsiraizde with Donyahzade, who afterwards, when the robberers shot up the socialights, came down into the world as amusers and were staged by Madame Sudlow as Rosa and Lily Miskinguette in the pantalime that two pitts paythronosed, Miliodorus and Galathee. The great fact emerges that after that historic date all holographs so far exhumed initialled by Haromphrey bear the sigla H.C.E. and while he was only and long and always good Dook Umphrey for the hungerlean spalpeens of Lucalizod and Chimbers to his cronies it was equally certainly a pleasant turn of the populace which gave him as sense of those normative letters the nickname Here Comes Everybody. An imposing everybody he always indeed looked, constantly the same as and equal to himself and magnificently well worthy of any and all such universalisation, every time he continually surveyed, amid vociferatings from in front of Accept these few nutties! and Take off that white hat!, relieved with Stop his Grog and Put It in the Log and Loots in his (bassvoco) Boots, from good start to happy finish the truly catholic assemblage gathered together in that king's treat house of satin alustrelike above floats and footlights from their assbawlveldts and oxgangs unanimously to clapplaud (the inspiration of his lifetime and the hits of their careers) Mr Wallenstein Washington Semperkelly's immergreen tourers in a command performance by special request with the courteous permission for pious purposes the homedromed and enliventh performance of the problem passion play of the millentury, running strong since creation, A Royal Divorce, then near the approach towards the summit of its climax, with ambitious interval band selections from The Bo' Girl and The Lily on all horserie show command nights from his viceregal booth (his bossaloner is ceilinged there a cuckoospit less eminent than the redritualhoods of Maccabe and Cullen) where, a veritable Napoleon the Nth, our worldstage's practical jokepiece and retired cecelticocommediant in his own wise, this folksforefather all of the time sat, having the entirety of his house about him, with the invariable broadstretched kerchief cooling his whole neck, nape and shoulderblades and in a wardrobe panelled tuxedo completely thrown back from a shirt well entitled a swallowall, on every point far outstarching the laundered clawhammers and marbletopped highboys of the pit stalls and early amphitheatre. The piece was this: look at the lamps. The cast was thus: see under the clock. Ladies circle: cloaks may be left. Pit, prommer and parterre, standing room only. Habituels conspicuously emergent.
segments.draft: 问题随之而来：此等记录于安德鲁-保罗-墨菲旁系双本叙事并获御准推重者，究竟是否为其得名封族之实据？我等于神律正邪之隙以女先知神谕读出者，究竟是否为其宿命？道旁果真全无马粪残渣？尼希米古邑果真足为我等安身之地？抑或马拉基至高王真可为我等临朝汗王？我等恐难立见分晓。法警乒乓交锋，在那王杖权标与半人马侍卫驻跸之处申领执照。智慧之子切记，腹中若有智识嚼子勒定，当明此人雄峻如山，凡欲攀登者必历尽变易造化。且抛开那既弄巧又琐屑之谬说——声称当年驾临者并非国王本尊，而是其形影不离之姊妹，彻夜饶舌之夜语者山鲁佐德与多尼娅扎德；待后来强盗枪击名流社交圈，二女下凡俗世充当戏子，由萨德洛夫人以罗莎与百合·米斯丹盖艺名搬上皮特父子赞助之哑剧《海利奥多鲁斯与伽拉忒亚》。重大史实赫然浮现：自那具有历史意义之日以后，凡迄今出土由哈伦弗雷手签之一切亲笔信札手稿，尽皆署有巨字暗码 H.C.E.；而在卢卡利索德面黄肌瘦之乞儿与密友眼中，他长久以来固然始终只是施粥之好心汉弗莱公爵与密友钦伯斯，市井大众赋予这组规约字母最妙趣横生之谐解，则是将其呼作全城妇孺皆知之绰号：“人人到场先生”！他举手投足端的是堂皇恢弘之众生法相，始终如一，与自身恒等，绝不辱没一切普遍化称颂；每一次他俯瞰台下，在前排“尝尝这几颗硬坚果！”、“摘掉那顶大白帽！”等喧嚣叫骂，以及“停其烈酒”、“记入日志”、低音长嚎“鞋底藏赃”之杂沓声浪中，从开场至终局巡视那齐聚王家剧院缎面光辉浮灯与脚灯上方、自各处叫驴荒野与二牛庄田涌入城中齐声击掌喝彩之真正普世民众（此乃其毕生灵感与伶人职业生涯巅峰），欣赏瓦伦斯坦·华盛顿·森珀凯利先生常青巡回剧团应特别御请、准作虔敬之用的客场助兴呈演——自创世以来盛演不衰、此时正奔向高潮之千禧受难问题剧《王室婚变》，以及马术展之夜由其准总督包厢管弦乐团雄心勃勃奏响之《波希米亚少女》与《基拉尼百合》间奏选段（其包厢华盖天顶虽比麦凯布与库伦两位红衣主教大红祭披稍显矮了一口唾沫）。在此处，俨如第 N 号真拿破仑，我等世界大舞台之恶作剧活宝兼退休凯尔特喜剧伶人，这位万民老祖恒常端坐，满门妇孺围坐身旁，常年摊开宽幅大手绢护抚后颈、颈窝与肩胛以纳凉，身穿硬挺衣柜嵌板般大礼服，前襟全然敞开，露出足称“吞纳万物”之阔面衬衫，全方位教池座与早期露天看台上浆洗硬挺之燕尾服与阔少仕绅相形见绌。好戏如斯：且看排灯。演职如斯：且看钟下布告。淑女包厢：外袍可存。池座、长廊与花厅：尽皆满员，只余站席。熟客纷然现身，济济一堂。
segments.translation:
问题来了。安德鲁保罗墨菲那两路旁支故事，或两路都有，或只一路，把这些记了下来，还加了封号。这些果真就是他得名入族的实情？咱在神许与神禁之间照女先知的口气读出的，真是他们的命数？路上没粪？咱的地方真会是无家米亚那样？对，还要让穆拉基当咱能称王的汗？怕没那么快见分晓。乒客乓客，要执照就找保人，权杖与香人马待的地方便是。记着，霍克玛之子，心当中若还勒着个嚼子，这个人是座山，往上攀，就是往变里攀。

且把那精巧又琐碎的腓尼巧话扔在一边。它说驾临的是国王那俩从不分开的姊妹，裙纱拉扎德和多尼娅扎德，两个夜话匣子，谁也管不住；国王本人倒没来。后来盗贼朝社交灯火开了枪，两人下到人世逗人开心，萨德洛夫人让她俩扮罗莎和莉莉·米斯金盖特，登台演那部潘塔青柠剧《米利奥多鲁斯与伽拉忒》，两位池座皮特花钱捧场。倒有一桩大事实冒出来。从那历史性的一天往后，迄今掘出的哈龙弗雷尔德亲笔件，凡他署过首字母的，都带 H.C.E. 这三个记号。卢卡利佐德那帮饿瘦的散工向来只认他作好公爵翁弗莱，老伙计管他叫钦伯斯。民众倒逗了个趣，顺这三个规矩字母，给他起个外号「瞧，大伙都来了」（Here Comes Everybody）。

好气派一个「大伙」。他确实一向如此，看着老是等于他自己，任何如此推而广之的称呼，他都当得起。每一回，他总在准总督包厢里往下看。前头喊「这几颗小坚果收着！」「摘下那顶白帽子！」其间又有「停他那杯掺水酒！」「记到日志上！」还有一声低音「靴里有赃！」从好开头看到欢喜收场，底下那群会众真够普天之广，又真够天主教。大伙从驴叫荒场、牛耕地赶来，聚在那座御宴剧场，台边灯和脚灯上方光泽如缎。齐声拍掌，齐声喝彩。一边是他一生的灵感，一边是艺人从艺以来叫座的好戏。瓦伦斯坦·华盛顿·森珀凯利先生那支长长青青巡演班奉命登台，应特别之请，蒙礼准许，为虔敬事业，上演自创世就连演火热的千世纪疑难受难剧《王室婚变》，在家场跑马地演到第一百一十一回，又活一回。戏正往高潮尖上赶。逢马展奉命演出之夜，中场乐队还大展抱负，选奏《波姑娘》和《百合》。他的独尊座，顶棚只比麦凯布和库伦的红礼帽低一丁点沫星。

这众人老祖真像拿破仑第 N 世。咱世界舞台上的恶作剧戏件，自有他一套，早退了行的凯尔特滑稽伶人。他一直在包厢坐着，一整个家围在周遭。照例摊开大手巾，给一整个脖子、后颈和肩胛骨纳凉。衣柜嵌板似的晚礼服全敞向两边，露出件配得上叫「全吞」的衬衣。论浆得硬挺，池座和前排环座那些洗过的燕尾衣、大理石顶的高柜绅士，样样都赶不上他。演什么戏？看灯。谁上场？看钟下。女宾圈座可存披风。池座、步廊、正厅只剩站位。熟客赫然现身。

notes.lemma: Comes the question are these the facts of his nominigentilisation
notes.text: nominigentilisation 把得名与氏族身分缀在一起，接上段别号由来，又让叙述者追问有几种见证。fata、fas、nefas 在第二问近形相接。Nohomiah 先借 no home 拟作「无家米亚」，尼希米与穆拉基所涉人名待查。

notes.lemma: Bear in mind, son of Hokmah, if so be you have metheg in your midness, this man is mountain and unto changeth doth one ascend.
notes.text: Hokmah 为希伯来语“智慧”；metheg 指希伯来圣经吟诵中的次重音与延音符号（字面意为马嚼子）。下文 Skertsiraizde 与 Donyahzade 变形自《一千零一夜》讲故事的姊妹山鲁佐德（Scheherazade）与多尼娅扎德（Dunyazad）；Rosa and Lily Miskinguette 兼涉双女名字与法国歌舞女伶 Mistinguett，pantalime 拼合哑剧（pantomime）与酸橙（lime）。以上跨语与剧场联想均为本项目推测。

notes.lemma: the nickname Here Comes Everybody.
notes.text: 这里依次写三种人给他的称呼。卢卡利佐德散工说好公爵翁弗莱，熟人叫钦伯斯，民众取三字头，为他起外号 Here Comes Everybody。译作「瞧，大伙都来了」，下句便沿「大伙」夸他的气派。

notes.lemma: A Royal Divorce, then near the approach towards the summit of its climax
notes.text: 1891 年 9 月 19 日《笨拙》杂志以戏谑口气写同名剧，点出威尔斯、拿破仑和约瑟芬。可核剧名与题材；小说所称巡演、场次、马展和中场曲目仍依小说词形。The Bo’ Girl 和 The Lily 暂保短题。

notes.lemma: Habituels conspicuously emergent.
notes.text: 三词首字母又是 H.C.E.，译文取「熟客赫然现身」，保人物突然入场，字母机关由此注补足。排灯、钟下、寄衣和站席的短句收住前一大串剧场铺陈。下段马上又说有人从这些字母里读出别意。

segments.original: A baser meaning has been read into these characters the literal sense of which decency can safely scarcely hint. It has been blurtingly bruited by certain wisecrackers (the stinks of Mohorat are in the nightplots of the morning), that he suffered from a vile disease. Athma, unmanner them! To such a suggestion the one selfrespecting answer is to affirm that there are certain statements which ought not to be, and one should like to hope to be able to add, ought not to be allowed to be made. Nor have his detractors, who, an imperfectly warmblooded race, apparently conceive him as a great white caterpillar capable of any and every enormity in the calendar recorded to the discredit of the Juke and Kellikek families, mended their case by insinuating that, alternately, he lay at one time under the ludicrous imputation of annoying Welsh fusiliers in the people's park. Hay, hay, hay! Hoq, hoq, hoq! Faun and Flora on the lea love that little old joq. To anyone who knew and loved the christlikeness of the big cleanminded giant H. C. Earwicker throughout his excellency long vicefreegal existence the mere suggestion of him as a lustsleuth nosing for trouble in a boobytrap rings particularly preposterous. Truth, beard on prophet, compels one to add that there is said to have been quondam (pfuit! pfuit!) some case of the kind implicating, it is interdum believed, a quidam (if he did not exist it would be necessary quoniam to invent him) abhout that time stambuling haround Dumbaling in leaky sneakers with his tarrk record who has remained topantically anonymos but (let us hue him Abdullah Gamellaxarksky) was, it is stated, posted at Mallon's at the instance of watch warriors of the vigilance committee and years afterwards, cries one even greater, Ibid, a commender of the frightful, seemingly, unto such as were sulhan sated, tropped head (pfiat! pfiat!) waiting his first of the month froods turn for thatt chopp pah kabbakks alicubi on the old house for the chargehard, Roche Haddocks off Hawkins Street. Lowe, you blondy liar, Gob scene you in the narked place and she what's edith ar home defileth these boyles! There's a cabful of bash indeed in the homeur of that meal. Slander, let it lie its flattest, has never been able to convict our good and great and no ordinary Southron Earwicker, that homogenius man, as a pious author called him, of any graver impropriety than that, advanced by some woodwards or regarders, who did not dare deny, the shomers, that they had, chin Ted, chin Tam, chinchin Taffyd, that day consumed their soul of the corn, of having behaved with ongentilmensky immodus opposite a pair of dainty maidservants in the swoolth of the rushy hollow whither, or so the two gown and pinners pleaded, dame nature in all innocency had spontaneously and about the same hour of the eventide sent them both but whose published combinations of silkinlaine testimonies are, where not dubiously pure, visibly divergent, as wapt from wept, on minor points touching the intimate nature of this, a first offence in vert or venison which was admittedly an incautious but, at its wildest, a partial exposure with such attenuating circumstances (garthen gaddeth green hwere sokeman brideth girling) as an abnormal Saint Swithin's summer and, (Jesses Rosasharon!) a ripe occasion to provoke it.
segments.draft: 有人将更卑污之含义附会于此等字母，其字面丑陋令体面之人难启其齿。某些饶舌狂徒四处嚷嚷（莫霍拉之恶臭正潜伏于清晨阴谋），妄断他染有花柳恶疾。真我天灵在上，剥夺其体面！面对此等无耻谰言，唯一自重之答辩便是严正声明：世上确有若干言论根本不应存在；且容人们补上一句：根本不该获准宣之于口！诋毁者这帮冷血之辈，俨然将他构陷为一条能犯下恶名录上一切滔天罪愆之大白毛毛虫，其行径直教朱克与凯利卡克退化劣族相形失色；他们妄言他在人民公园骚扰威尔士皇家燧发枪兵，同样无济于补强其讼词。嘿呀，嘿呀，嘿！嚎呀，嚎呀，嚎！草地上的半羊林神与花仙女最爱这桩古老笑话。凡在其漫长洁白、毫无劣迹之准总督任上熟知并敬爱这位宽厚圣洁大巨人 H. C. 埃尔威克之人，闻听此等声称其为在圈套中嗅探是非的色欲侦探之诬蔑，无不觉其荒诞至极。凭先知胡须起誓，实情迫使人们补叙：当年确曾有过（呸！呸！）牵涉某无名之辈（若无此人，亦必因由捏造一具）之类似案由；此人身负案底，穿着漏水球鞋在都柏林四处游荡，隐其真容（且称其为阿卜杜拉·加梅拉夏尔克斯基），据传曾在纠察队警士敦促下遭马伦警局通缉；多年后，更有甚者长嚎，此君在霍金斯街老罗奇黑线鳕酒馆引颈企盼，单等月初配给之碎肉排果腹。“看哪，你这金发骗子，上帝在暗处盯着你呢，家里那泼妇正败坏这些疮疤！”这顿残羹冷炙里端的是盛满窝囊羞恼。诽谤即便极尽平铺直叙之能事，亦休想坐实我等伟大良善、卓尔不群之南部绅士埃尔威克（某虔敬作家称其为‘天生纯粹之人’）犯下任何比这更重的失检——几名林苑巡守官（泰德、汤姆、塔菲德三守卫心虚不敢否认，当天曾狂饮谷物烈酒）指控他于芦苇丛生之深凹低洼处，面对一双娇俏女仆，举止有失绅士体统、略显放浪；两名围裙侍女亦辩称，完全出于造化天真，适逢黄昏同一时辰前往解手；而其公开发表、如丝毛交织之证词，即便并非动机堪疑，在触及隐秘真相之细节处亦大相径庭，一如干涸迥异于啼泣；此节至多不过是侵犯林木猎鹿特权之初犯，诚属失慎鲁莽，穷极推论，亦不过是在异常酷热的圣斯威辛盛夏——且伴有极易诱发此举之大好时机（耶西之根与沙仑玫瑰啊！）等减轻罪责之情势下——稍微暴露体肤而已。
segments.translation:
这几个字母，还有人往下贱里解。稍顾体面，连那字面意思也几乎不好透露。一些抖机灵的嚷着传开了（清晨的夜谋里，有莫霍拉特的臭气），说他患了恶疾。阿特玛，摘了这帮人的礼数！遇上这种暗示，自重的人只有一句话可回：有些话原就不该有，但愿还能加一句，根本不该准人开口。诋毁他的是一族半温血的东西，显然认他是条大白毛虫，凡恶事年表记在朱克、凯利凯克两家账上的坏事，他样样干得出来。那帮人又换个说法，影射他有一度担了个荒唐罪名，说他在人民公园滋扰威尔士燧发枪兵。这也没替那帮人把话说圆。嗨，嗨，嗨！嗬，嗬，嗬！草地上的牧神花神，最爱那一桩老笑话。大个儿 H. C. 埃尔威克心思洁净，当了那么久的无恶副王，爱他那副基督心肠的人，光听说他是个色探子，往呆鸟套里嗅麻烦，就觉得荒唐透顶。

真话呀，给先知戴上胡子，也逼着咱添一句。据说从前倒有桩类似的事（呸！呸！），有人有时也信，说牵涉某个家伙（要是压根儿没这人，那也非造一个不可）。那一阵，他穿双漏水胶鞋，背着一册黑案底，在敦巴林东绊西晃，当地至今还说不出他的名字（且给他涂个名，阿卜杜拉·加梅拉克萨尔克斯基）。据说警戒委员会那班巡守武士一催，马伦那儿便挂出了他的名。好多年后，有位更大的权威又喊了一声「同上」。在那些吃得苏丹一样饱的人看来，那位似乎专荐吓人的事，说他垂下头（呸呀！呸呀！），等月头轮到的那份果食，那块排呀、那点卷心菜呀，找个地儿记在老店账上，给那个死抠账的，霍金斯街拐出去的罗奇黑线鳕。瞧，你这金发骗子，老天在那记号地瞧见你啦！家里那位伊迪丝沾污了这几个疔疮小子！那顿饭吃出满满一马车的羞臊。

任诽谤照它最平实的样子说，也从未能给咱那善良伟大、颇不寻常的南方客埃尔威克，那位虔诚文人所谓的「同才一人」，坐实更重的失检。所能举出的，也只是几名守林人或巡察员声称，他曾在芦洼的闷热里，当着两位俏女仆举止不够绅士，不合规矩。那几个守望的可不敢抵赖，当天灌下了谷之精魂，干杯泰德，干杯塔姆，干杯干杯塔菲德。据那两位长裙围兜辩称，是天性娘娘清清白白、自自然然，约莫在傍晚同一时辰打发两人到那里的。可是合在一处发表的证词，丝掺着毛，纯不纯且有疑，两份在私密细节上却明摆着分岔，如瓦普之于韦普。这是犯着树木或鹿肉的头一遭。诚然有欠小心，可往最狂里说，也只露了一点。这还有从轻的缘故（园子发绿处，自由佃农娶姑娘）：圣斯威辛的夏天异常，又逢（耶西丝，沙仑的玫瑰哟！）时机熟透，正好惹出来。

notes.lemma: certain wisecrackers (the stinks of Mohorat are in the nightplots of the morning)
notes.text: 恶疾出自传话者。叙述者接着把「本不该有」递进成「不该准人开口」。Mohorat、Athma 先留音形，相关语言和词源待考。

notes.lemma: a great white caterpillar capable of any and every enormity

segments.draft: 我等少不得她们！妻子们，快快奔向各自的安歇之所！男人且在放浪享乐之际纵情放荡。前路乃远古开端，村落交织，各凭造化。抖擞精神，换个新天地！她若为夜魔莉莉丝，须早早拔足！波琳，且由她去！画匠恶徒蒙羞，自当深藏暗处！对于加诸其身的诸多罪名，他委实无辜；他至少有一回坦荡自白，口吻中仍带几分早年喉音，故而我等确信此乃实情。人们传讲这桩故事（其融汇杂糅之妙，正如氯化钙与疏水海绵）：某个春风骀荡的四月中旬早晨（正值其当年赤身披挂盛装、为人类各族混杂大混乱奠基的周年纪念日），在传闻中的越轨恶行发生千百年后，造物万灵的忠实老友手拄虎木拐杖，跨着大步，在我国最大的公园辽阔草地上如波浪起伏般穿行；他头戴橡胶便帽，束着大宽带，系着兽皮囊，外罩粗绒蓝袍，脚蹬铁骑长靴与薄伽梵护腿，身披涂胶因弗内斯斗篷；就在此处，他撞见一个嘴叼烟斗的无赖汉。后者手拈硫磺火柴，头无圣光光环（此人十有八九至今仍戴着同一顶破草帽到处闲逛，肩头搭着翻出羊毛的大衣，好装作乡绅模样，并随心所欲签署禁酒誓约），冒冒失失迎上前搭讪道：“健力士黑啤足下好呀先生借个火？”（那年月都柏林市井惯用的寒暄，若干老古董至今忆及仍心有余悸）；实则借题探问目下钟敲几点，只因他的表走得极慢，不知撞上何等时运。迟疑显然必须避免；辱骂更须巧妙消解。面临这促狭一瞬，埃尔威克深体自由主义基本原则，自知肉体生命不论自何维度而言皆至关重要（近处能赶来救援者只有隔年圣帕特里克节与芬尼亚起义），更不愿当场被暗壕中射出的软鼻钝弹送进永生；他当即止步，拔枪般敏捷，一面应声自称安好，一面从枪袋摸出于尔根森榴霰弹华特堡怀表（依共产之道归我等公有，依时效占有归其私蓄）；与此同一瞬间，越过刺骨东风，听到南方荒原上映斑教堂里老钟乐师福克斯·古德曼正全力撞响十吨重雷鸣男高音巨钟（库丘林之召！）；他当即指着耶和华向打听的滑头断言：此刻正是恒星时兼酒馆开桶之正午十二点整。随后，他深深躬身，喷出一口熏沙丁鱼般的口臭（好为自己呈现的指针增添分量），节外生枝地补充道：至于先前针对他的那桩传闻指控（即《摩根邮报》所载、上流阶层皆知之流言），纯属某个形同人类、实则远逊常人且比昔日三头九头毒蛇还要下作数倍的怪物蓄意罗织。为进一步佐证其誓言（此语奇妙预言了后世名言，已由诺亚·韦伯斯特从口述体原样记录为永恒韵律，收入题为《H.C.埃尔威克言行录》的定本之中，售价先令，邮资全免），亚麻发色的该亚斯巨人咚咚敲击怀表外壳；在案发当场的环周河漫滩平原上霍然挺直身躯，一只戴柏林长手套的手臂弯曲架在肘弯（依远古手势图谱，此姿势意为倒转巨字 Ǝ！），呈三十二度角指向铁公爵那座巍峨界碑方尖碑，当作决斗抵押信物；稍作停顿，他满腔激愤、庄严发誓：“握、握个手，同、同志！仅我一人，面对他们那五位，乃是公平决斗。我赢得光明磊落。由此始有我名扬全国之旅店与乳品工坊产业；为了我们共育爱女之体面，信我吧，先生，我随时甘愿站上那座丰碑——那象征我们救赎的记号，指着开卷《圣经》和至高大主宰，在神明本尊、在英国高教会派圣米尚堂主教与主教夫人面前，在所有同住街坊以及五湖四海讲我这纯正英国骨气话语、遵奉公道正义的每个生灵面前，向我等同胞赌咒起誓：即便为此判我终生监禁，在那桩至纯至净的捏造谎言之中，也绝无半点真实，容我当面奉告！”
segments.translation:
少不得她俩。妻子，快冲向你那歇脚所！趁律还嘻着，从夫的就往男人那里去。泽西德是咱的卡德姆，篱上编，篱上摘。费库普，看在肉身内莉份上，世界新，佐勒弗伦！她若是朵莉莉丝，趁早拔！波琳，准了吧！伏在树丛的画手，藏黑里，藏黑里！扣到他头上的事，有许多他分明没做过，至少有一回，他分明这样亲口说过。话音还带点从前的卷舌腔，所以传到咱这里，便当了真。

故事是这么讲的（这么一团混合物，氯化钙加拒水海绵，能吸多足就吸多足）。距那所谓越轨事老早老早之后，一个喜洋洋、风飕飕的四月望日清早（恰逢周年纪念，当年他头一回穿上那套欢乐生辰服，连带有权把人间各族搅得混混沌沌），万物的老相识拄根虎木路杖，在咱最大的公园里昂昂荡荡走过大片空地。他头戴橡胶军帽，腰束大带，挎皮袋，衣穿蓝芬克斯粗绒布，脚蹬铁甲长靴，扎薄伽梵绑腿，披胶面因弗内斯斗篷，便碰上个带烟斗的粗汉。那粗汉，擦硫火的那位，头顶没光环（十有八九至今还戴那顶草帽转悠，胳肢窝下夹外衣，羊皮面翻在外，好扮得跟乡绅更像，签个戒酒誓也快活得很），硬气地迎头搭话：「健力士，陶图尔，因朱米，迪纳乌泽尔芬？」（黑池那时好一句问候，咱有几位老辈想起来兴许还发抖。）这是问他碰巧知不知道钟打了几点，因为自己的表慢了。

显见迟疑得避开，咒骂也得巧巧撇开。就在这一催一迫的当口，埃尔威克照自由派根本原则，明白无论联结还是罪责，肉身这条命都顶要紧（最近的接力救援，是乒乒、击倒、圣帕特里克日与芬尼亚起事），也不愿这会儿就让壕沟来的软头子弹一弹送进永恒。他站定，快如拔枪，答说身子硬朗得像根警杖；好，照提示，从枪袋里掏出那只于尔根森榴霰弹沃特伯里表。按共领共用，它归咱；按据久为有，它归他。恰同一记，他越过凶东风妈妈的尖啸，听见南面旷野那头的老钟师福克斯·古德曼，在花斑教堂敲那十吨、轰吨、雷响的男高音大钟（库胡宁在叫！）。便对问时辰的滑头小子说，耶和华作证，十二点了，按恒星时，也按大杯酒时。他还深弯下去，一口熏沙丁鱼气，要给亮出来的铜棍添点分量（不过这和塞在嘴边的姜似乎有点混混淆淆；那姜混混调了酸料、酸质、盐料、甜料和苦料，据咱所知，他拿来嚼嚼，补骨、补肌、补血、补肉、补活命劲）。说到朝他来的那桩嚼舌指控，上头晓得，《摩根邮报》也登得明白，出自个披人模样的东西，平准都不够，比古来的三头水蛇还低好几等。

为再给那话撑一撑（这话奇巧地先道了后来一句名言，照仪式拍子，在罗马公民式的静穆中，从口说重新捏成万世可读的话，又由诺亚·韦伯斯特从前后各本拼在一起，编进《归于 H. C. 埃尔威克的言语》，价若干先令，邮递免费），金发巨高斯咚咚敲了敲自己的计时表，挺直了站在周遭泛滥平原上方，也就是那事发生的地方。一只柏林长手套夹在肘弯里（照最古的手势说，这姿势意为 Ǝ！），他斜三十二度指向铁公爵那座草长过头的里程碑，配他的押信为证。顿了一顿，才带着庄严动情的火气断言：「握、握手，同、同志！单我一个，对他们五个，他，那是势均力敌。我赢得正当。所以我才有这遍布非全国的旅馆与乳品坊。为了咱共、共家的女儿名声，信我，先生，直到这会儿，哪天卫生合宜，我都愿、愿站上那座碑，咱赎、赎罪的标记，向我那伙辛芬人发誓，就为这事判我终身也认。按着摊开的《圣经》，当着大主宰的（我脱帽！），当着神本身，也当着英国高教会米尚主教和太太，同住近邻和世上不论哪一角的每个活魂，只要说我这英国到骨子里的话、用交换之正义，容我告诉您，那最纯的谎、谎编里，一丁点真也没有！」

segments.draft: 瞠目吉尔敏于窥破破绽，严于自持收敛（其耳咽管断定，此人乃典型的青春期后脑垂体亢进型海德堡穴居巨兽）；他微抬前倾的帽檐，随口念诵‘圣母保佑’与都柏林问候，贪鄙顺从地应承对方；鉴于此等凶险话题何其微妙，他宛如深谙人情世故的市侩，审时度势，谢过赏赐的烟资与所报时辰（心下却深疑那绝非天主正点时间）；他恭谨拜别这位内阁重臣，任其自去填补深壑、填塞腐朽空虚；他自顾前行，例行公事般向过路行尸致敬（若有人存心追踪倒也不难，其头屑掉落堆成的小丘早已标出踪迹）；身旁紧随忠犬与内心恒常反思：“早鸟啊，我与你相逢太晚，抑或你这条早起肥虫撞见我过早！”当晚黄昏，在德鲁伊古境与深眠瀚海之间诸吟游诗人聚首长舌闲聊之际，他以转述口吻，将大人物那番结巴言辞尽可能一字不差地复述；时值晚餐与沙拉坦商场夜市降临，沿着大运河与皇家运河的沉沉暮色，耳语飞掠，潜入树篱。他一边遥望空中楼阁，一边在自家炉石旁故作虔诚地吐出一圈摩西十诫般的唾沫（此乃爱尔兰纯正唾沫，试问叹气先生或欢笑先生等衣冠楚楚、自命欧陆名门的体面仕绅，口袋里明明塞着手帕，又岂会这般肆意当街啐唾？）。他饱餐一顿被其附庸风雅命名为‘孟买仙桃’的糊烂肉汤炖菜（实则不过是卢坎粗制豆馅饼，经其婆娘撒了芥末与胡椒），佐以山羊奶白麦酸汁揉成的豌豆丸；在这鼻涕横流的湿冷寒季，老赖大快朵颐，馋嘴如鼠得茴香；为庆贺此番侥幸脱险，更兼借酒壮胆，这盘以波兰橄榄作为天顶中轴的本土炖肉杂烩，极其奢靡地（肥油猪肉啊！）配上一瓶1898年凤凰酒厂佳酿，随后又续上一瓶皮斯波特名庄特级白葡萄酒；对这两款照亮餐桌的琼浆，他固执地狠嗅其落满蛛网的陈年木塞。
segments.translation:
张口吉尔，迎合别人的错话快，管束自己严。（他循耳咽管诊断，这番打交道牵涉海德堡人洞穴伦理里一型颇显眼的过了青春期、垂体还特大的家伙。）他掀起斜朝前的帽子，向斯韦塔戈尔道了声好早，添个都布好夜，贪心巴巴，感激得很。这凶险话题一碰就着，他倒像个识趣的戏子，处处周到，谢过到手的荷兰盾，也谢过人家报时（其实那些钟点居然全是上帝的钟点，倒真叫他一怔）。然后，他谦谦恭恭，照礼数问候他的蒂斯克公使，愿镀缝人给张嘴客和你那些发霉的空处镀上金。就去忙他的事了，管他是什么人，照尸例向死尸一路行礼（有心的话，倒也能一路追猎这人，落下的一丘丘头皮和头屑，自会给人指路）。跟着他的，有他那忠心的呼噜伴，还有他那句老念头，说来就是：鸟啊，碰上你太晚啦，要不就是蠕虫来得又肥又早。他给呆子添个签，用他第二张嘴那门话，把当天傍晚还能巴巴巴想起来的大人物原话，照字一遍遍说了出来。

那时还没到德鲁伊境与沉睡海之间吟游客乱啾乱叽的时辰。晚饭时光和去夏拉坦街的念想一齐轻轻来。顺着大与皇家两道静静暗下去的水，咻咻，掠过去，又咔咔，溜进篱里。软舌头常说俏话，有声答得更柔，吻也更轻；阿尔万达总安安静静应承。他一面看风里楼台，一面望诺兰那边牛粪点点，劳驾，他又郑重其事地朝炉石四周吐下一圈马赛克式的摩西律令（爱尔兰唾沫，毛舍多霍勒。可堂堂一个爱欧出身、门路体面、念头都穿得齐整、懂规矩的人，像且叹先生或且笑先生，明明兜里塞着条花手帕，会这么狠心往外吐？可谢了，呸！）。

吃过那碟醉炖浓汤，他便捧着心思喂他的缪斯。那一碟，他嫌土，偏起个名叫「孟买桃」（其实不过是卢坎普坎蘑饼，还是那谁知道，是谁拿芥味、胡椒给他调过的）。一碟顶顶好的豌豆，在明肖格奶下揉成团儿，揉进白麦芽酸酒里。这点口粮，流鼻水的季节里，那小赖账鬼哑着嗓也吃得有味。笑就笑吧，他爱吃得像耗子爱茴香。这回为庆幸脱险，为给酒壮的胆子戴顶冠，那本地菜、水煮肉里最小最宠的一盘，顶心正好搁一粒斯波利什橄榄，便大富大贵地（猪肥膘好啊！）同一瓶费尼切布吕厄里 ’98 拜堂，随后又娶一瓶皮耶斯波特、大恶狗名酿。两盏心爱的席上灯啊（酒香虽淡，也是情郎一别的花束），他偏要硬嗅那塞子，上头还结着蛛网。

notes.lemma: lufted his slopingforward, bad Sweatagore good murrough and dublnotch on to it
notes.text: 先掀斜着的帽子，再道问候，随后感谢钱与报时。问候里 murrough 近 morrow，dublnotch 还可听出双层与夜声。洞穴、耳管与垂体写得像诊断书；人种名和地名所指待证。

notes.lemma: saluting corpses, as a metter of corse
notes.text: corse 可听作 course，也接刚说的尸体，译作「照尸例」。后面头皮与头屑给追踪者标路。鸟与虫的格言先说来晚，接着又说来早，保留这道反折。

notes.lemma: he spat in careful convertedness a musaic dispensation about his hearthstone
notes.text: 炉石旁的唾沫同时牵出拼花与律令。插语又问，一个自称体面、兜里有手帕的人怎会照样吐？句尾偏又「呸」一声。Grand 与 Royal 暂按两道水路译，具体地理待考。

notes.lemma: it is rawly only Lukanpukan pilzenpie which she knows which senaffed and pibered him
notes.text: 括号拆穿「孟买桃」的派头。pilzen、senaffed、pibered 可分别听出蘑菇、芥味、胡椒；末两词的施事与多语来源尚待考，暂不替原句定出厨师身份。

notes.lemma: a Piessporter, Grand Cur
notes.text: 皮耶斯波特可比德语酒地名形 Piesporter。当地资料列有 Piesporter Goldtröpfchen；这里只核地名与葡萄酒用法。原作却加一个 s，又用 Cur 代 Cru，译文听作「大恶狗」。’98 未写全，先留两位年号。

segments.original: Our cad's bit of strife (knee Bareniece Maxwelton) with a quick ear for spittoons (as the aftertale hath it) glaned up as usual with dumbestic husbandry (no persicks and armelians for thee, Pomeranzia!) but, slipping the clav in her claw, broke of the matter among a hundred and eleven others in her usual curtsey (how faint these first vhespers womanly are, a secret pispigliando, amad the lavurdy den of their manfolker!) the next night nudge one as was Hegesippus over a hup a' chee, her eys dry and small and speech thicklish because he appeared a funny colour like he couldn't stood they old hens no longer, to her particular reverend, the director, whom she had been meaning in her mind primarily to speak with (hosch, intra! jist a timblespoon!) trusting, between cuppled lips and annie lawrie promises (mighshe never have Esnekerry pudden come Hunanov for her pecklapitschens!) that the gossiple so delivered in his epistolear, buried teatoastally in their Irish stew would go no further than his jesuit's cloth, yet (in vinars venitas! volatiles valetotum!) it was this overspoiled priest Mr Browne, disguised as a vincentian, who, when seized of the facts, was overheard, in his secondary personality as a Nolan and underreared, poul soul, by accident—if, that is, the incident it was an accident for here the ruah of Ecclectiastes of Hippo outpuffs the writress of Havvah-ban-Annah—to pianissime a slightly varied version of Crookedribs confidentials, (what Mère Aloyse said but for Jesuphine's sake!) hands between hahands, in fealty sworn (my bravor best! my fraur!) and, to the strains of The Secret of Her Birth, hushly pierce the rubiend aurellum of one Philly Thurnston, a layteacher of rural science and orthophonethics of a nearstout figure and about the middle of his forties during a priestly flutter for safe and sane bets at the hippic runfields of breezy Baldoyle on a date (W. W. goes through the card) easily capable of rememberance by all pickersup of events national and Dublin details, the doubles of Perkin and Paullock, peer and prole, when the classic Encourage Hackney Plate was captured by two noses in a stablecloth finish, ek and nek, some and none, evelo nevelo, from the cream colt Bold Boy Cromwell after a clever getaway by Captain Chaplain Blount's roe hinny Saint Dalough, Drummer Coxon, nondepict third, at breakneck odds, thanks to you great little, bonny little, portey little, Winny Widger! you're all their nappies! who in his neverrip mud and purpular cap was surely leagues unlike any other phantomweight that ever toppitt our timber maggies. 'Twas two pisononse Timcoves (the wetter is pest, the renns are overt and come and the voax of the turfur is hurled on our lande) of the name of Treacle Tom as was just out of pop following the theft of a leg of Kehoe, Donnelly and Packenham's Finnish pork and his own blood and milk brother Frisky Shorty, (he was, to be exquisitely punctilious about them, both shorty and frisky) a tipster, come off the hulks, both of them awful poor, what was out on the bumaround for an oofbird game for a jimmy o'goblin or a small thick un as chanced, while the Seaforths was making the colleenbawl, to ear the passon in the motor clobber make use of his law language (Edzo, Edzo on), touchin the case of Mr Adams what was in all the sundays about it which he was rubbing noses with and having a gurgle off his own along of the butty bloke in the specs.
segments.draft: 无赖汉那位浑家（娘家姓巴雷妮丝·麦克斯韦尔顿）生就一双听辨唾沫的灵耳，照例做完粗粝家务，趁在利爪中转动钥匙之际，于次夜就着一杯热茶，在一百一十一桩琐事中，微屈双膝向其私家神父倾诉此事；她双眼干瘪，语带迟疑，只因丈夫形容怪异，仿佛再也无法忍受那帮老母鸡；她深信双唇相附与《安妮·劳里》之誓，以为如此封进神父耳廓、深埋于爱尔兰炖肉香气中的闲话，绝不会越出耶稣会士僧袍半步。然而酒后吐真言，飞羽终传扬！正是这位备受纵容的布朗神父——乔装为遣使会修士，待获悉实情之后，却在其身为‘诺兰’的次生人格中，偶于鲍尔多伊尔海风习习的赛马场投注避险之机，教旁人听了个正着；在此处，希波教父《传道书》灵风压过夏娃之女的笔端，他借一曲《身世之谜》旋律，以最低极弱之语调，向一位年过四旬、略显发福的乡土科学与正音学兼职教师菲利·瑟斯顿那只微红耳朵倾吐‘夏娃歪肋骨密语’；彼时正值全城马迷牢记于心的经典赛事——圣达洛战驹抢先脱缰，在终点线前挫败大热门克伦威尔，矮个骑师维尼·维杰策骑夺魁！当时，恰有两名唤作‘糖蜜汤姆’与‘轻佻矮子’的无业游民在场——前者刚因偷窃一条芬兰猪腿刑满出狱，后者乃是其同一母乳喂大的把兄弟、刚从囚船爬出来的马场扒手；二人身无分文，正四处游荡寻觅金币横财；正值锡福斯步兵团军乐队高奏《风流浪女》之际，二人隔着车窗，恰好听见坐在汽车里的神父卖弄法言法语，一边与戴眼镜的矮胖同伴碰杯痛饮，一边大谈各家周报上闹得沸沸扬扬的‘亚当斯先生那桩丑案’。
segments.translation:
咱那烟斗客的冤家娘子（娘家叫巴雷妮丝·麦克斯韦尔顿），耳朵一听痰盂就灵（后话是这么说的）。她照例闷声收拾家务（桃也没你的，杏也没你的，波梅兰齐娅！），却把钥匙往爪里一溜，次夜捧杯茶，像赫格西普斯似的用肘一碰，照例屈一屈膝，在一百一十一桩闲话中挑出这桩来说。（男人那吵窝里，女人头几声晚祷多么细，私下嘁嘁，私下嚓嚓！）她眼干眼小，舌头略涩，那人脸色怪，活像再受不住这几只老母鸡。她要说给自己那位神父、那位灵修导师听，本来头一个想到的就是他（嘘，请进！只消一顶针勺！）。嘴唇凑杯，诺言唱得像《安妮·劳里》（愿她过新岁，还能给那一窝啄嘴小鸡弄来埃斯内克里布丁！）。她信这份闲话福音送进他的书信耳，随茶点埋到爱尔兰炖锅深处，便出不了他的耶稣会袍。

可酒里有真谎，飞鸟传万事！偏偏是这位宠坏过头的布朗神父，扮成遣使会会士，听到实情后又摆出诺兰这第二副人格，可怜小鸡魂，一低声说就让旁人听见。据说是偶然。倘若这事果真叫偶然，因为此地希波那位教会传道者一口灵气，吹过了哈娃·班·安娜女书吏。那天在风吹鲍尔多伊尔跑马场，神父小赌一把，下注求个稳妥。他把弯肋密语稍换个说法，以最最弱音往外道（阿洛伊丝姆妈只为耶稣芬说了些什么呀！），手握在手中，赌咒效忠（我的好英兄！我的好妇人！），和着《她的身世之谜》，静静扎进菲利·瑟恩斯顿那只微红的耳朵。此人是个俗家教员，教乡土科学和正音伦理，身架近胖，四十五上下。

那日（W. W. 把赛程表挨项过完）好记得很，凡拾掇全国大事和都柏林小事的人，成对的珀金与保洛克，贵族与平民，想来都记得。那场经典的鼓励挽马杯，随军牧师布朗特上尉的狍色骡「圣达洛」巧一脱出，终点挤得一块马毯都能盖住，挨颈贴颈，有些又无些，伊维洛内维洛，险赔之下以两鼻之差抢下杯来，压过奶油色小公马「勇小子克伦威尔」。鼓手考克森，不上画面的第三。都靠你啊，了不起的小维尼·维杰、俏小子、圆敦敦的小子！你可真是这群马的尿布！那身沾泥撕不破，头顶紫紫红帽，他同那些曾跃过咱木栏的鬼魂轻量级，简直差出几里格。

就有两个闯祸的蒂姆伙计（风雨过了，雨水来了，草场轰声传遍咱田地）。一个叫糖蜜汤姆，偷了一条基霍、唐纳利和帕肯汉家的芬兰猪腿，刚出班房。另一个是同血同乳的兄弟欢蹦矮子（要分毫不差地说，又矮又欢蹦），是个报马料的，刚离旧囚船。两个穷得要命，四下晃荡，想找个有钱鸟，弄枚金币或小厚币，全看撞上什么。锡福斯团正奏得科琳叫，两人便听见那位穿摩托行头的牧师打起官司腔（如此，如此等等），说那星期日报上处处登的亚当斯先生案。他正同戴眼镜的矮壮伙计碰鼻凑头，自家也咕咚喝上一口。

notes.lemma: knee Bareniece Maxwelton
notes.text: knee 近似表示婚前姓名的 née。Maxwelton 也见于《安妮·劳里》歌谱首句，本段稍后又提及歌名。保留姓氏与歌名照应；最初的歌谱及乔伊斯所据版本仍待考。

notes.lemma: was overheard, in his secondary personality as a Nolan
notes.text: 此处同一位布朗神父又挂诺兰之名。实际接话者是俗家教员菲利。叙述者先说偶然听见，旋即质疑「偶然」。诺兰的其他暗引待证。

notes.lemma: was captured by two noses in a stablecloth finish
notes.text: 叙述写两鼻之差，接着明列考克森第三。暂按圣达洛胜过奶油色小公马理解。stablecloth 与后面的挨颈连写，译作挤在一张马毯下；此处只核小说里的赛况。

notes.lemma: following the theft of a leg of Kehoe, Donnelly and Packenham's Finnish pork
notes.text: 两人履历分开：偷猪腿后出来的是糖蜜汤姆，刚从旧囚船下来的报马料人是欢蹦矮子。两人都穷，正找机会弄钱。商号和钱币面值待查。

notes.lemma: while the Seaforths was making the colleenbawl
notes.text: colleenbawl 近布西科剧名 The Colleen Bawn，又像姑娘大叫。现译「科琳叫」留这层声响。南佛罗里达大学藏提示本可核剧名；赛场实际吹奏何曲待考。

segments.original: This Treacle Tom to whom reference has been made had been absent from his usual wild and woolly haunts in the land of counties capalleens for some time previous to that (he was, in fact, in the habit of frequenting common lodginghouses where he slept in a nude state, hailfellow with meth, in strange men's cots) but on racenight, blotto after divers tots of hell fire, red biddy, bull dog, blue ruin and creeping jenny, Eglandine's choicest herbage, supplied by the Duck and Doggies, the Galopping Primrose, Brigid Brewster's, the Cock, the Postboy's Horn, the Little Old Man's and All Swell That Aimswell, the Cup and the Stirrup, he sought his wellwarmed leababobed in a housingroom Abide With Oneanother at Block W.W., (why didn't he back it?) Pump Court, The Liberties, and, what with moltapuke on voltapuke, resnored alcoh alcoho alcoherently to the burden of I come, my horse delayed, nom num, the substance of the tale of the evangelical bussybozzy and the rusinurbean (the 'girls' he would keep calling them for the collarette and skirt, the sunbonnet and carnation) in parts (it seemed he was before the eyots of martas or otherwales the thirds of fossilyears, he having beham with katya when lavinias had her mens lease to sea in a psumpship doodly show whereat he was looking for fight niggers with whilde roarses) oft in the chilly night (the metagonistic! segments.draft: 前文提及的糖蜜汤姆，此前已有好些时日未在各郡草莽旧地现身（实则常年混迹于下等大车店，与各路喝甲醇的潦倒汉赤身同榻而眠）；但在赛马之夜，饱饮‘地狱烈火’、‘红比蒂’、‘斗牛犬’、‘蓝劫难’与各色毒酒之后，醉卧于自由民区水泵院‘彼此相伴’廉租公寓，翻江倒海连环狂吐，带着浓烈酒气，含混结巴地发出鼾声，哼唱着‘我来也，座骑迟延’，断断续续将福音胖教士与城乡大巨人的秘闻吐露无遗（因其领圈裙裾与红石竹胸花，他一口咬定那是两名‘姑娘’）。在那寒气砭骨的夜里，这番烦躁梦呓全教同铺几个穷困潦倒的汉子听了去：被解职的小布商管事彼得·克洛兰，无定居之所的前私人秘书奥马拉（坊间戏称‘霉烂丽莎’，曾露宿冰岛门廊，枕着比人膝与妇人胸膛更为冰冷的命运石），以及落魄街头卖艺歌手霍斯蒂（好生响亮的名号！）。霍斯蒂无衣无食，深陷忧郁深渊，在草垫铺盖上辗转反侧，满心盘算如何弄到一把鲁格手枪，搭上电车奔赴沿线小酒馆，一枪崩掉自己这颗祸胎脑壳，在烈酒绝命弹中求个清净解脱。翌日清晨，天色微明，勤快杂役刚着手擦拭锅盖、门铜与学童红润脸蛋，这位重新振作的卖艺歌手与同卧铺友们（‘我等好儿郎’，正如拜伦所称）便从这处爱称为‘木桶’的猪窝客栈一跃而起，踏着都柏林清晨寒气穿街过巷；克鲁斯古提琴嘎吱嘎吱、如怨如诉、欢快跳跃，琴声拂过节日圣王芬纳蒂治下臣民的耳际——那些端坐红砖屋舍、耽于草莓甜梦之辈，微张着势利之口，期待这翘首以盼的弥赛亚咆哮巨作。行经当铺，他们稍事驻足，先去赎回歌手那副叹为观止的假牙；随后长驱直入圣塞西莉亚教区库雅斯广场之‘老酒鬼之窟’酒馆，离格莱斯顿首相雕像基座不远；在此处，这帮江湖浪子又逢上一位刚领了周薪津贴的失意绅士，后者慷慨解囊买单请客；在一顿单身汉酒席与烈酒催生的高昂义气中，这群无赖踏出酒肆，衣袖擦拭着笑咧的嘴角，如盖尔热血少年般放声高歌；押韵者的天地从此平添一曲绝妙歌谣，而大众合唱界委实欠这位民间歌手一份崇高致敬——皆因他将这首传唱世间至恶妖魔兼最具风骨化身之颂歌，永远镌刻于这颗星球的旋律版图之上。
segments.translation:
上头说到的糖蜜汤姆，在那之前有阵子没踏进小马各郡那片狂野毛茸的老地盘（其实他常跑公共栈房，跟甲基酒称兄道弟，赤身躺在素不相识的汉子床上）。赛马那晚，他喝得一塌糊涂。几盅地狱火、红比蒂、斗牛狗、蓝败家、爬藤珍妮，都是埃格兰丁的上好草料，出自鸭与小狗、飞跑报春花、布里吉德酿酒家、公鸡、邮童号、小老头、瞄准万事好、杯与镫这几家。他回自由区水泵院 W. W. 栋（干吗没押它一注？），在「彼此同住」合住屋里找到了暖热的床。多多一吐，滚滚再吐，他又打起鼾，酒、酒、酒话居然连得上，合着「我来哉，我马迟迟」那句副歌（哝、喃），说了那福音忙嘴客和乡城区佬那档子事（凭短领围、裙子、遮阳帽和康乃馨，他老管这两位叫「姑娘」）。他一截截说（似乎是在玛尔塔的小洲前，或在别处化石年头的三分时，拉维尼娅租了月期出海，上的是艘蒸汽船把戏，他正跟卡佳火腿合拍，找黑人打架，还放出野马似的吼声）。冷夜里睡不安稳，呼噜话一回又一回（换了个争场！史诗般的新婚房！），屋里人都听见了。

有个小个子、一文不名的现款布商干事彼得·克洛兰（东家已辞了他）；有个没固定住处的前私人秘书奥马拉（当地叫他霉丽莎），说来也怪，他已在门洞里披无家可归的毯子睡了几夜，铺在冰乡，枕着命运之石，比男人膝盖、女人乳房都冷；还有霍斯蒂（名字可不弱），时运不济的岸边卖唱人。没一口食，也没一点剩渣，他怀疑自己坐在木菌凳上，再过去就是自身的深渊。他快饿枯了，什么事都叫他愁（夜缅人，你给他端来夜莺的小小一盅！）。一头麻黄发在临时草铺上翻来滚去，盘算种种搞钱的办法。他倒爱凭什么伊菲达许可，想方设法在本国从谁手里搞到一支帕拉贝鲁姆，好搭趟顺风便车，落到钝基、下劳里、阴岩一带电车线外某家侧轮陋店。花两枚小钱，便能在那一枪准的瓶底享清静。他想瞄准了，把自己那颗自杀杀亲的脑袋轰到大胆波罗的高处。原来经格里斯尔太太好心帮忙，他十八个历月有余，想尽办法，要从帕特里克·邓恩爵士医院出去，经汉弗莱·杰维斯爵士医院，进阿德莱德医院的圣凯文床（躲开这一班难医的韦尔斯莱，熬过那些没人管的哀哀日，经扇贝帽的圣地亚哥，好拉撒路，救救咱吧！）。偏是怎么钻营也钻不通。

丽莎·奥戴维斯和罗奇·蒙根（两人的灵性有不少相通之处，容咱说一句，hostis et odor insuper petroperfractus），心照不宣，同霍斯蒂卧在甜甜摇晃的翻身铺母亲怀里，睡了个斯温游水觉，像林里的小后生、燕麦间的土乡亲，唔，或荒野里的挥霍汉。忙乎乎的粗使小破晓（报以颂歌，喘着气唱！）才擦亮锅盖、门铜、学生的苹果脸和举火童的金属物，没过几眨眼，那灰斗上心、嘴里像在说「不，伙计，他给白人闹培根去」的卖唱人又活泛了（跟他同窝那几位闹腾一好夜，早上又一顿胫火腿，人简直换了一个）。他和醒透了的一伙卧房随员（用咱的拜伦说，「咱的好小子」）起了身，脚拖脚出了唤作「大桶」的猪窝，穿过埃布林冷村。（当时地面上三路三歇的线和点，奇巧地对上咱如今两便士半地铁在地皮底下探行的轨道与站点。）一把克鲁斯琴嗡响领路，克雷呜咽又克罗低吟、轻轻重重、俏俏绕绕、欢欢蹦蹦，还真奏得起来，摩挲着节庆圣王芬纳蒂臣民的耳朵。各人睡在自家砖房，躺在香香的草莓床上，卖蜜人、播薰衣草的、鲜博因鲑鱼的喊声全顾不上，张着讲体统的嘴，等着好好评赏久候的咆哮神剧弥赛啊；这会儿才刚睡到呼噜半点。

众人到当铺快停一停，赎出歌手那副着实可叹的假牙，好添齿、也好添音。又到库雅斯广场一家常落脚的地方长坐，嘶，正是大乐自由区圣塞西莉堂区的「老醉鬼窟」。照格里菲斯估值，这儿离首相格拉斯通雕像旧址还不到一千又一国里；那雕像替造者进军划了根火柴（也许是最后一位管家吧）。话说回来，哼拨弦儿歌的三人又添一位「有意者／明日来／再说」的临时伙计，还有个从前阔过、方才拿到每周那点羞辱的体面人，呸啐。满座嚼舌头（谁说名词来着？），都有了提神的吉、吉斯酒，出自那位该死的体面人。光棍午饭过后，为庆昨天再来几口，酒火一热，交情也烧旺了。这帮淘气货便出了持牌酒铺（布朗在前，后头凄凄落着那小小附言似的前前任干事，帽子托手上，像女士信末附言：我要钱。请寄来），一面用袖子擦那笑漏了的嘴唇。这帮小子大抵怎样喊他们的歌呀（辛芬呀，辛芬的歌呀）。押韵人的天地便果真多了一首准歌谣。合唱的共谣体得谢那写歌人，他给这颗星球的乐图添了一支曲，写世上最卑污的鬼眼货、又最惹眼惹讼的化身，历来最叫世界没法交代的一个。

notes.text: 八个店名依次跟在五种酒名后。汤姆随后才回合住屋；W. W. 与前段赛程表照应。酒肆与合住屋的现实原型待考。

notes.lemma: for upwards of eighteen calanders to get out of Sir Patrick Dun's, through Sir Humphrey Jervis's and into the Saint Kevin's bed in the Adelaide's hosspittles
notes.text: 原句先说邓恩处出去，再经杰维斯处，目标是阿德莱德医院的圣凯文床；十八个历月有余，始终没办成。格里斯尔太太帮忙，长括号中仍有朝圣呼救。此处按小说所说列次序，医院沿革待考。

notes.lemma: to the thrummings of a crewth fiddle
notes.text: 威尔士国家博物馆藏品 39.78.1 为弓奏的威尔士 crwth。小说写 crewth fiddle，兼带拨响、低吟等声影，故译琴声嗡响。随后赎假牙又用 prothetic，让添齿与添音相接。

notes.lemma: the Old Sots' Hole in the parish of Saint Cecily within the liberty of Ceolmore
notes.text: 店、堂区、自由区三层地名连写，再用估值口气量到雕像旧址的距离。「一千又一」沿原数；人物、雕像与所在地址待证。

notes.lemma: like a lady's postscript: I want money. Pleasend
notes.text: 附言式的索钱声嵌在队尾，后面才转高声叫唱。attractionable 暂作「惹眼惹讼」，兼留吸引及可追究；下段再交代歌谣首次唱出的场合。

segments.lead_in: This, more krectly lubeen or fellow — me — lieder was first...
segments.original: This, more krectly lubeen or fellow—me—lieder was first poured forth where Riau Liviau riots and col de Houdo humps, under the shadow of the monument of the shouldhavebeen legislator (Eleutheriodendron! Spare, woodmann, spare!) to an overflow meeting of all the nations in Lenster fullyfilling the visional area and, as a singleminded supercrowd, easily representative, what with masks, whet with faces, of all sections and cross sections (wineshop and cocoahouse poured out to brim up the broaching) of our liffeyside people (to omit to mention of the mainland minority and such as had wayfared via Watling, Ernin, Icknild and Stane, in chief a halted cockney car with its quotal of Hardmuth's hacks, a northern tory, a southern whig, an eastanglian chronicler and a landwester guardian) ranging from slips of young dublinos from Cutpurse Row having nothing better to do than walk about with their hands in their kneepants, sucking airwhackers, weedulicet, jumbobricks, side by side with truant officers, three woollen balls and poplin in search of a croust of pawn to busy professional gentlemen, a brace of palesmen with dundrearies, nooning toward Daly's, fresh from snipehitting and mallardmissing on Rutland heath, exchanging cold sneers, massgoing ladies from Hume Street in their chairs, the bearers baited, some wandering hamalags out of the adjacent cloverfields of Mosse's Gardens, an oblate father from Skinner's Alley, bricklayers, a fleming, in tabinet fumant, with spouse and dog, an aged hammersmith who had some chisellers by the hand, a bout of cudgel players, not a few sheep with the braxy, two bluecoat scholars, four broke gents out of Simpson's on the Rocks, a portly and a pert still tassing Turkey Coffee and orange shrub in tickeyes door, Peter Pim and Paul Fry and then Elliot and, O, Atkinson, suffering hell's delights from the blains of their annuitants' acorns not forgetting a deuce of dianas ridy for the hunt, a particularist prebendary pondering on the roman caster, the tonsure question and greek uniates, plunk em, a lace lappet head or two or three or four from a window, and so on down to a few good old souls, who, as they were juiced after taking their pledge over at the uncle's place, were evidently under the spell of liquor, from the wake of Tarry the Tailor a fair girl, a jolly postoboy thinking off three flagons and one, a plumodrole, a half sir from the weaver's almshouse who clings and clings and chatchatchat clings to her, a wholedam's cloudhued pittycoat, as child, as curiolater, as Caoch O'Leary. The wararrow went round, so it did, (a nation wants a gaze) and the ballad, in the felibrine trancoped metre affectioned by Taiocebo in his Casudas de Poulichinello Artahut, stumpstampaded on to a slip of blancovide and headed by an excessively rough and red woodcut, privately printed at the rimepress of Delville, soon fluttered its secret on white highway and brown byway to the rose of the winds and the blew of the gaels, from archway to lattice and from black hand to pink ear, village crying to village, through the five pussyfours green of the united states of Scotia Picta—and he who denays it, may his hairs be rubbed in dirt! To the added strains (so peacifold) of his majesty the flute, that onecrooned king of inscrewments, Piggott's purest, ciello alsoliuto, which Mr Delaney (Mr Delacey?), horn, anticipating a perfect downpour of plaudits among the rapsods, piped out of his decentsoort hat, looking still more like his purseyful namesake as men of Gaul noted, but before of to sputabout, the snowycrested curl amoist the leader's wild and moulting hair, 'Ductor' Hitchcock hoisted his fezzy fuzz at bludgeon's height signum to his companions of the chalice for the Loud Fellow, boys' and silentium in curia! (our maypole once more where he rose of old) and the canto was chantied there chorussed and christened where by the old tollgate, Saint Annona's Street and Church. And around the lawn the rann it rann and this is the rann that Hosty made. Spoken. Boyles and Cahills, Skerretts and Pritchards, viersified and piersified may the treeth we tale of live in stoney. Here line the refrains of. Some vote him Vike, some mote him Mike, some dub him Llyn and Phin while others hail him Lug Bug Dan Lop, Lex, Lax, Gunne or Guinn. Some apt him Arth, some bapt him Barth, Coll, Noll, Soll, Will, Weel, Wall but I parse him Persse O'Reilly else he's called no name at all. Together. Arrah, leave it to Hosty, frosty Hosty, leave it to Hosty for he's the mann to rhyme the rann, the rann, the rann, the king of all ranns. Have you here? (Some ha) Have we where? 这曲子，准一点说是卢宾对歌，或「跟我来」的利德歌，头一回唱出来，就在里奥利维奥闹水、乌多山口拱起的地方，在那位本该当立法者的纪念碑影下（自由之树啊！樵夫，手下留情，手下留情！）。伦斯特万邦来开会，挤得满眼都是人。一大群人同一条心，有面具，有真脸，足抵利菲河边横切竖切各色人（酒坊与可可茶馆倾巢涌出，把开桶畅饮的场面挤得满满当当），更不必说来自大陆主岛的少数派，以及取道沃特林、厄尔敏、伊克尼尔德与斯泰恩古道跋涉而来的旅客——为首的是一辆停驻的伦敦佬马车，载着定额的哈德穆斯铅笔文丐：一名北方托利党人、一名南方辉格党人、一名东盎格利亚编年史家，外加一名西地卫报记者。人群五花八门：有从剪包街晃出来、闲得无聊只能双手插在及膝短裤兜里四处游荡的都柏林半大少年，嘴里吮着吹泡硬糖，也就是说大块头砖糖，身旁并肩走着逃学稽查员、三颗羊毛球当铺招牌与寻觅典当面包皮的爱尔兰府绸；直到步履匆忙的体面行业绅士；一对留着邓德里长连鬓胡、刚在拉特兰荒原打中沙锥鸟却打偏野鸭的外圈要塞区绅士，正午晃向达利俱乐部，彼此交换着冷笑；从休姆街乘轿赶去做弥撒的贵妇人，轿夫正在打尖歇脚；从毗邻莫斯花园的三叶草田里闲逛出来的几个流浪汉；来自皮匠巷的一位献身会神父；泥水匠；一个身穿冒烟爱尔兰毛葛、携妻带狗的弗拉芒人；一个手里牵着几个小毛头的老铁匠；一伙比试棍术的汉子；好几只染了快疫病的绵羊；两名蓝衣公学学童；从「礁上辛普森」出来的四个穷光蛋绅士；在赊账铺门前继续啜饮土耳其咖啡与香橙甜酒的一胖一俏；彼得·皮姆与保罗·弗莱，接着是埃利奥特，噢，还有阿特金森，正因年金领受者的橡子脓疮痛得死去活来；当然也没漏两位等着出猎的狄安娜；一位苦苦琢磨罗马卡斯特、剃顶问题和希腊合一派（扔下吧）的宗派主义牧师会教士；从窗口探出的一两个、三四个饰蕾丝垂带的妇人头颅；如此一路数下去，直到几个老好人——他们在当铺大叔那里发过戒酒誓后又灌饱了酒汁，显然正中了烈酒的魔咒；从“裁缝塔里”守灵夜走来的一位俊俏姑娘；一个心里盘算着三壶外加一壶酒的快活邮童；一个滑稽古怪、来自织工济贫院的半吊子先生，紧紧巴着、死死贴着、喋喋不休黏着她那件云彩色的整身衬裙，活像孩童，活像古玩迷，活像盲人奥赖利。战箭传过一圈，可不是嘛（一个民族总想看热闹）；这首歌谣采用泰奥切博在《普钦内罗·阿塔胡特之屋》中所偏爱的费利布尔派切分韵律，匆匆拓印在一张空白纸条上，顶头印着一幅极其粗糙的红墨木刻，由德尔维尔韵律印刷所私下承印，转眼间便沿白大道与褐小道，随罗盘风玫瑰和盖尔风，从拱门吹向格窗，从黑手掌传入粉耳朵，村村传呼，将秘密传遍皮克特苏格兰合众国绿意盎然的五省四方——谁若敢矢口否认，就教他的头发在泥垢里摩擦！伴着长笛陛下——那乐器中独戴一冠的君王、皮戈特琴行最纯正的极品、高音直入云霄——额外奏出的（何等祥和繁复的）旋律，号手德拉尼先生（德拉西先生？）料想吟客必定掌声如雨，便从那顶体面的帽子里吹出声来，正如高卢人所留意到的，瞧上去越发酷似他那位腰包鼓鼓的同名人物；但未及四处喷溅唾沫，当那领唱者蓬乱脱落的头发间露出一绺雪白卷发之际，“指挥”希区柯克将他那顶毛茸茸的土耳其毡帽高举到短棒齐高处，朝一同举杯的伙计打手势，要请大嗓门出场。伙计，法庭肃静！（我们的五月花柱再度在往昔升起之处耸立），歌章便在彼处旧收费关卡、圣阿诺纳街与圣阿诺纳堂旁高声吟唱、齐声合唱并受洗得名。歌谣绕草地跑，跑着跑着，就是霍斯蒂编的这支歌。

（道白）博伊尔家与凯希尔家，斯克雷特家与普里查德家，既已入诗亦已穿刺化名，愿我们传述的真树在顽石中长存。副歌列在这里。
有人荐他叫维克，有人赞他叫迈克；
有人管他叫林、芬，有人喊卢格、巴格、丹、洛普、莱克斯、拉克斯、冈或金。
有人叫他阿思，有人给他施洗叫巴思、科尔、诺尔、索尔、威尔、维尔、沃尔。
可我拆出个珀斯·奥赖利，要不他呀，半个名字也没有。

（齐唱）哎呀，交给霍斯蒂吧，冷峻的霍斯蒂，交给霍斯蒂吧，只因他是给歌谣押韵的好汉，这歌谣，这歌谣，万谣之王！你听这儿有？（有人有）咱哪儿有？（有人没）你听见这儿了？（另有人听）咱听见哪儿了？（另有人不听）来了，轰隆隆来了！啪嗒，啪嗒！（全体鼓掌）玻璃碎裂声。那一声（klikkaklakkaklaskaklopatzklatschabattacreppycrottygraddaghsemmihsammihnouithappluddyappladdypkonpkot！）。

｛｜勇起来，勇士！
音乐提示。

《珀斯·奥赖利歌谣》

notes.lemma: (Eleutheriodendron! Spare, woodmann, spare!)
notes.text: 莫里斯诗首行请樵夫饶那棵树。乔伊斯在相近呼告前加 Eleutheriodendron，可拆听自由与树。中文沿「樵夫，手下留情」保呼告；歌类与地名的具体对应待核。

notes.lemma: an overflow meeting of all the nations in Lenster fullyfilling the visional area and, as a singleminded supercrowd, easily representative, what with masks, whet with faces, of all sections and cross sections (wineshop and cocoahouse poured out to brim up the broaching) of our liffeyside people (to omit to mention of the mainland minority and such as had wayfared via Watling, Ernin, Icknild and Stane, in chief a halted cockney car with its quotal of Hardmuth's hacks, a northern tory, a southern whig, an eastanglian chronicler and a landwester guardian)
notes.text: Watling, Ernin, Icknild and Stane 指不列颠岛四条古代干道（Watling Street, Ermine Street, Icknield Way, Stane Street）；车上四名来自北、南、东、西的报人（Tory, Whig, East Anglian Chronicler, Manchester Guardian 变形）与四方见证者结构相呼应。Hardmuth 指铅笔制造商 Koh-I-Noor Hardtmuth。

notes.lemma: ranging from slips of young dublinos from Cutpurse Row having nothing better to do than walk about with their hands in their kneepants, sucking airwhackers, weedulicet, jumbobricks, side by side with truant officers, three woollen balls and poplin in search of a croust of pawn to busy professional gentlemen
notes.text: 本段长句列举汇聚听歌的都柏林各色人群与地名：Cutpurse Row（剪包街）、Daly's（达利俱乐部）、Hume Street（休姆街）、Mosse's Gardens（罗伯特·莫斯医生设立的产科医院花园）、Skinner's Alley（皮匠巷）、Simpson's（辛普森盲人与痛风病患医馆），以及 Pim、Fry、Elliot、Atkinson 等都柏林织物与百货商号姓氏。

notes.lemma: The wararrow went round, so it did, (a nation wants a gaze) and the ballad, in the felibrine trancoped metre affectioned by Taiocebo in his Casudas de Poulichinello Artahut, stumpstampaded on to a slip of blancovide and headed by an excessively rough and red woodcut, privately printed at the rimepress of Delville
notes.text: wararrow 令人联想古苏格兰与爱尔兰召集部族的传战木十字（fiery cross / crann tara）。felibrine 指十九世纪普罗旺斯文学复兴团体“费利布尔派”（Félibrige）；Delville 为都柏林北郊格拉斯内文庄园名（十八世纪帕特里克·德拉尼博士与斯威夫特常往来之处）。

notes.lemma: 'Ductor' Hitchcock hoisted his fezzy fuzz at bludgeon's height signum to his companions of the chalice for the Loud Fellow, boys' and silentium in curia! (our maypole once more where he rose of old) and the canto was chantied there chorussed and christened where by the old tollgate, Saint Annona's Street and Church.
notes.text: Piggott's 指都柏林格拉夫顿街皮戈特琴行（Pigott & Co.）。'Ductor' Hitchcock（拉丁语 ductor“领队／指挥”）举帽杖高呼拉丁语“silentium in curia!”（法庭肃静！），众人遂在旧收费关卡与圣阿诺纳街堂旁合唱并为歌谣命名。

notes.lemma: Some vote him Vike, some mote him Mike, some dub him Llyn and Phin
notes.text: 列名由 Vike／Mike 起，以 Persse O’Reilly 定音。现译留这些短名的声形及名称逐个冒出的节拍。结名可近听法语 perce-oreille，呼应前文蠼螋；具体语音借合仍待核。

segments.draft: 此曲（更确切地说是叠句讽唱歌，或是跟我唱的领唱连环谣）初度放歌之处，正值利菲河（Riau Liviau）翻波、霍斯岬角（col de Houdo）驼隆之所，掩映于本该成就大业的立法家纪念碑之阴影下（自由之树啊！樵夫，手下留情，手下留情！）。集会溢出会场，全伦斯特省各邦万人空巷，填满目力所及的视界；这支万众一心的超迈人群，有的覆以面具，有的亮出真容，轻而易举便代表了我们利菲河畔子民的所有阶层与各界名流（酒肆与可可茶铺倾巢而出，倾杯注酒共赴狂欢），更毋庸赘述那来自英伦主岛的少数过客，以及沿着沃特林、厄尔敏、伊克尼尔德与斯泰恩四大古道跋涉而至的游人——领头的正是一辆驻足观望的伦敦佬敞篷马车，载着一整批哈德穆斯铅笔描摹的下等报贩：北境托利党人、南方辉格党人、东盎格利亚编年史客，外加一位西地卫报记者。群像包罗万象：自剪包街游荡而来的都柏林青葱少年，闲极无聊，双手插在紧身及膝裤兜里，吮吸着硬壳大糖块（即所谓巨无霸甜砖）；在他们身旁，逃学稽查员、织工当铺的三颗羊毛球与爱尔兰府绸正四处寻觅典当的面包皮；步履匆忙的体面士绅，几位留着邓德里长连鬓胡、从外圈要塞区来的老贵族正往达利俱乐部晃去赶午宴，刚在拉特兰荒野打了沙锥鸟却漏了野鸭，彼此交换着冰冷的嘲诮；从休姆街乘轿前去做弥撒的贵妇人，轿夫正在歇马受饵；从莫斯花园毗邻苜蓿地闲逛而出的流浪脚夫；来自皮匠巷的献身会修士；泥水匠；身着冒烟爱尔兰毛绦呢、携妻带犬的弗拉芒织工；手里牵着几个毛头小鬼的年迈铁匠；一伙挥棒互击的棍术好手；好几头染了羊肠疽的病羊；两名蓝袍公学门生；从辛普森破落避难所出来的四位破产先生；在挂账铺门前继续啜饮土耳其咖啡与香橙甜烈露的一胖一俊；彼得·皮姆与保罗·弗莱，随后还有埃利奥特，哎呀，更有阿特金森，正因领受年金者的痔疮痛得死去活来；当然少不了两位盛装待猎的狄安娜女猎手；一位钻牛角尖的教俸领受人，苦苦琢磨着罗马复活节日历、修士剃发式规制与希腊东仪天主教公案，管他们去死；从临街窗棂探出的一二三四顶饰蕾丝飘带发套的女眷；往下更有一撮老好人，在当铺掌柜跟前发过戒酒誓后痛饮饱蘸，显然仍在烈酒的魔力笼罩之下；从“缝纫匠塔里”守灵夜走来的一位姣好姑娘；一位心心念念想着三坛外加一坛美酒的快活邮童；一个傻头傻脑、来自织工济贫院的半吊子乡绅，紧紧贴着、死死抱住、嘁嘁喳喳黏附着她那如云似雾的完整衬裙，恰似孩童，恰似古玩狂人，恰似盲人奥莱利。传战箭绕境飞驰，正是如此（一个民族总渴求众目聚焦）；这首按泰奥切博在《普钦内罗阿塔胡特之屋》所钟爱的费利布尔切分断节韵律写就的歌谣，仓促拓印在一张空白传单上，顶头缀有一幅极粗糙的朱红木刻，由德尔维尔私人韵律印刷所秘密印制；转眼间，其机密便随风飘向白昼大道与幽暗小径，吹向罗盘八面风与盖尔风潮，自门廊直抵格窗，从乌黑手掌传入粉嫩耳廓，村村呐喊相闻，穿透皮克特苏格兰诸联合邦绿意葱茏的五省四区——谁若敢抵赖，就教他的毛发在泥垢里搓揉！伴随着长笛陛下那分外安详的合奏之声——那乐器中独一无二的至尊加冕之王，出自皮戈特琴坊的极品，宛如大提琴，又兼鲁特琴——德拉尼先生（抑或是德拉西先生？）持号角而出，预期吟诵盲侠中必将掀起一阵雷动的掌声，从他那顶体面礼帽中吹响管乐，高卢人见之，更觉其酷肖那囊囊满袋的同名先贤；然而未及唾沫横飞，在那领唱者散乱脱落的发丝间现出卷曲白霜之际，“指挥家”希区柯克将毛糙假发高悬于短杖顶端，作为向高脚杯诸位同侪示意“大嗓门先生”的信号：“小的们，法庭肃静！”（我们昔日拔地而起的五月花柱重现此间），歌篇便在此地高声吟咏、齐声合唱并获洗礼得名——就在那昔日旧收费关卡、圣阿诺纳街与圣阿诺纳教堂之侧。诗韵绕着草坪奔流，这便是霍斯蒂写就的歌谣诗节。道白。博伊尔家与凯希尔家，斯克雷特家与普里查德家，既已入诗亦已化石，愿我们传唱的真理之树在磐石中长青。此处排起副歌之行。有人选他作维京霸主，有人推他为迈克尔大公，有人称他为林恩与芬恩，另有人奉他作卢格、臭虫、丹、瘸子、法度、三文鱼、枪炮抑或吉尼斯。有人唤他亚瑟，有人为他施洗称巴塞洛缪、科尔、诺尔、索尔、威尔、威廉、城墙，但本人将他剖析为皮尔斯·奥莱利，否则他就根本无名无姓。齐声合唱。哎呀，全交给霍斯蒂，冷傲的霍斯蒂，全托付给霍斯蒂，因为他是押韵成诵的铁汉，这歌谣，这诗章，万谣之王！你们这里有吗？（有人答：有）我们哪里有？（有人答：无）你们听见了吗？（旁人答：听见了）我们去何处找？（旁人答：找不着）来了，轰隆隆来了！嗒嗒，嘚嘚！（全体拍手）玻璃粉碎。那一声（klikkaklakkaklaskaklopatzklatschabattacreppycrottygraddaghsemmihsammihnouithappluddyappladdypkonpkot！）。

segments.lead_in: Have you heard of one Humpty Dumpty...
segments.original: Have you heard of one Humpty Dumpty How he fell with a roll and a rumble And curled up like Lord Olofa Crumple By the butt of the Magazine Wall, (Chorus) Of the Magazine Wall, Hump, helmet and all? He was one time our King of the Castle Now he's kicked about like a rotten old parsnip. And from Green street he'll be sent by order of His Worship To the penal jail of Mountjoy (Chorus) To the jail of Mountjoy! Jail him and joy. He was fafafather of all schemes for to bother us Slow coaches and immaculate contraceptives for the populace, Mare's milk for the sick, seven dry Sundays a week, Openair love and religion's reform, (Chorus) And religious reform, Hideous in form. Arrah, why, says you, couldn't he manage it? I'll go bail, my fine dairyman darling, Like the bumping bull of the Cassidys All your butter is in your horns. (Chorus) His butter is in his horns. Butter his horns! (Repeat) Hurrah there, Hosty, frosty Hosty, change that shirt on ye, Rhyme the rann, the king of all ranns! Balbaccio, balbuccio! We had chaw chaw chops, chairs, chewing gum, the chickenpox [and china chambers Universally provided by this soffsoaping salesman.
segments.draft:
你可曾听说过矮胖子（Humpty Dumpty）？
听他滚滚隆隆摔得粉碎，
蜷缩得活像奥洛法·克伦威尔勋爵（Lord Olofa Crumple），
瘫倒在弹药库高墙的底座根脚，
    （副歌）在那弹药库的高墙下，
            驼背、头盔，样样丢光？

他曾是我们城堡的国王，
如今像烂熟老欧洲防风草任人踢滚。
尊贵的大法官下令，从绿街法庭押解他，
径直关进芒特乔伊苦役苦牢，
    （副歌）押进芒特乔伊大牢！
            大牢关他，万民同乐。

他是扰乱万民百般诡计的始作爹爹，
给庶民开慢吞吞马车与无瑕避孕药，
给病患喝母马奶，每周七天滴酒不沾，
野外露天调情与宗教改制，
    （副歌）还有宗教改革，
            面目可憎！

哎呀，你问他何以招架不住？
我敢作保，我那俊俏的奶夫宝贝，
活像卡西迪家乱撞的公牛，
你浑身的黄油全长在角尖上。
    （副歌）他的黄油长在犄角上。
            抹油擦角！

（重唱）霍斯蒂好样的，冷傲的霍斯蒂，换掉你身上那件衬衫，
押你的诗韵，万谣之王！

               恶结巴，丑口吃！
我们嚼过咀嚼大肉排、坐过椅子、嚼过口香糖，得过水痘，用过夜壶瓷便盆，
全由这巧舌如簧的推销奸商一手兜售。
segments.translation:
可曾听过那位亨普蒂·邓普蒂，
怎样滚啊隆隆往下跌，
蜷成奥洛法·克伦普尔爵爷那样，
就在火药库墙根脚？
    （合唱）火药库的墙根脚，
            驼峰、盔帽，一齐倒？

从前他是咱的城堡王，
眼下成了根烂欧防风，任人踢来踢去。
法官大人一发令，就从绿街送他走，
送进芒特乔伊惩戒牢。
    （合唱）送进芒特乔伊牢！
            关他，咱乐陶陶！

他是那一切烦人花样的爹、爹、爹，
给百姓慢马车、无玷避孕具，
给病人母马奶，一星期七个无酒主日，
露天恋爱，改宗教。
    （合唱）改呀改宗教，
            改出丑模样。

哎呀，你说，他怎么管不了？
我敢作保，我那好奶商、亲心肝，
就像卡西迪家撞人的公牛，
你那黄油全在角上。
    （合唱）他那黄油全在角上。
            给他的角抹黄油！

（重唱）好啊霍斯蒂，冰霜霍斯蒂，换件衫再来！
押韵呀，押歌谣，万谣之王！

               巴巴结，巴布口！
咱有嚼嚼肉排、椅子、口香糖、水痘
               ［还有瓷夜壶，
全归这位软皂嘴推销商分给大伙。

notes.lemma: And curled up like Lord Olofa Crumple
notes.text: 现译并置童谣人名与爵爷的变形名。Crumple 与蜷缩呼应，也可近听 Cromwell；Olofa 所指待考。高墙在词中是坠下之后挨着的地方，原句没说他从哪儿跌落。

notes.lemma: And from Green street he'll be sent by order of His Worship
notes.text: 这是歌中的将来时。先出法官命令，再从绿街押送，合唱回环芒特乔伊的牢与 joy。译文用「牢／陶陶」拾回听觉连带。

notes.lemma: He was fafafather of all schemes for to bother us
notes.text: 「爹、爹、爹」对应首字反复，后接车、避孕具、马奶、禁酒主日、露天恋爱与宗教改革。immaculate 可兼听无玷受孕，译作「无玷避孕具」。

notes.lemma: Arrah, why, says you, couldn't he manage it? I'll go bail, my fine dairyman darling, Like the bumping bull of the Cassidys All your butter is in your horns.
notes.text: 歌中将乳品商（dairyman）比作“卡西迪家乱撞的公牛，黄油全长在牛角上”，讥刺其徒具顶撞气势而产不出乳脂黄油（horns 亦常兼涉戴绿帽之角）。

notes.lemma: Balbaccio, balbuccio! We had chaw chaw chops, chairs, chewing gum, the chickenpox [and china chambers Universally provided by this soffsoaping salesman.
notes.text: Balbaccio, balbuccio 源自意大利语 balbo / balbettare（结巴、口吃）加贬义后缀 -accio / -uccio；随后以 ch- 头韵连缀碎肉排（chops）、椅子（chairs）、口香糖（chewing gum）、水痘（chickenpox）与瓷夜壶（china chambers），底本在“[and china chambers”前保留折行方括号“[”。soffsoaping 双关抹软肥皂与花言巧语奉承（soft-soaping）。

segments.lead_in: Small wonder He'll Cheat E'erawan our local lads nicknamed him...
segments.closing: ...(bis) That's able to raise a Cain.
segments.original: Small wonder He'll Cheat E'erawan our local lads nicknamed him When Chimpden first took the floor (Chorus) With his bucketshop store Down Bargainweg, Lower. So snug he was in his hotel premises sumptuous But soon we'll bonfire all his trash, tricks and trumpery And'tis short till sheriff Clancy'll be winding up his unlimited company With the bailiff's bom at the door, (Chorus) Bimbam at the door. Then he'll bum no more. Sweet bad luck on the waves washed to our island The hooker of that hammerfast viking And Gall's curse on the day when Eblana bay Saw his black and tan man-o'-war. (Chorus) Saw his man-o'-war. On the harbour bar. Where from? roars Poolbeg. Cookingha'pence, he bawls Donnez- [moi scampitle, wick an wipin'fampiny Fingal Mac Oscar Onesine Bargearse Boniface Thok's min gammelhole Norveegickers moniker Og as ay are at gammelhore Norveegickers cod. (Chorus) A Norwegian camel old cod. He is, begod. Lift it, Hosty, lift it, ye devil ye! up with the rann, the rhyming rann! It was during some fresh water garden pumping Or, according to the Nursing Mirror, while admiring the monkeys That our heavyweight heathen Humpharey Made bold a maid to woo (Chorus) Woohoo, what'll she doo! The general lost her maidenloo! He ought to blush for himself, the old hayheaded philosopher, For to go and shove himself that way on top of her. Begob, he's the crux of the catalogue Of our antediluvial zoo, (Chorus) Messrs. Billing and Coo. Noah's larks, good as noo. He was joulting by Wellinton's monument Our rotorious hippopopotamuns When some bugger let down the backtrap of the omnibus And he caught his death of fusiliers, (Chorus) With his rent in his rears. Give him six years. 'Tis sore pity for his innocent poor children But look out for his missus legitimate! When that frew gets a grip of old Earwicker Won't there be earwigs on the green? (Chorus) Big earwigs on the green, The largest ever you seen. Suffoclose! Shikespower! Seudodanto! Anonymoses! Then we'll have a free trade Gaels' band and mass meeting For to sod the brave son of Scandiknavery. And we'll bury him down in Oxmanstown Along with the devil and Danes, (Chorus) With the deaf and dumb Danes, And all their remains. And not all the king's men nor his horses Will resurrect his corpus For there's no true spell in Connacht or hell (bis) That's able to raise a Cain.
segments.draft:
难怪本地小伙给他起个绰号：“人人他都坑”（He'll Cheat E'erawan），
当年钦普登初次登场亮家底，
    （副歌）开着他那廉价投机铺，
            就在下便宜路街头。

他曾舒舒服服缩在奢华旅店宅第，
但转眼我们要架起篝火，烧尽他的破烂、诡计与骗局，
用不了多久，克兰西警长就会清算他那无限责任公司，
更有法警的重锤砰砰擂门，
    （副歌）乒乒乓乓砸大门。
            看他还能无赖混多久。

好一番晦气，浪涛冲上我们海岛，
那铁锤维京蛮霸的破双桅船；
异族人的诅咒降临那一天，埃布拉纳海湾
眼睁睁见着他那黑褐双色铁甲战舰。
    （副歌）见着他的铁甲战舰。
            横在海港沙洲前。

何方神圣？普尔贝格灯塔怒吼。哥本哈根铜板贩子，他高叫：“赏我两文，养活哭哭啼啼全家老小！”
芬戈尔·麦克·奥斯卡·阿尼辛·肥腚·博尼法斯，
那是老子古老的挪威海盗名号，
如今我是个老挪威鳕鱼老光棍。
    （副歌）一头老挪威骆驼老鳕鱼。
            天晓得，他当真是。

唱响它，霍斯蒂，唱响它，你这捣蛋鬼！高唱歌谣，高唱押韵连环诗！
正当给鲜水花园汲水抽泵之际，
抑或按《护士镜像》所言，正当他欣赏猴群之时，
我们那重量级异教蛮霸汉弗莱，
斗胆向一位纯真少女求欢，
    （副歌）呜呼，她该如何是好！
            将军失手，丢了滑铁卢处女堡！

他真该自个儿脸红，这满头乱草的老哲学家，
竟硬生生朝人家身上霸王硬上弓。
凭上帝起誓，他是我们洪荒前动物园
名录图鉴中的头号难题，
    （副歌）卿卿我我两掌柜。
            诺亚百鸟，完好如新。

他曾在惠灵顿纪念碑前颠簸晃荡，
我们那声名狼藉的河马巨兽，
冷不防哪个混账撂下公共马车的后车门，
燧发枪士兵当场将他逮个正着，
    （副歌）屁股上裤管撕开大窟窿。
            判他服苦役整整六年。

可怜他那无辜苦命的儿女，
但且留神他那明媒正娶的原配悍妻！
一旦那黄脸婆死死揪住老埃尔威克，
草坪上岂不大爆蠼螋恶斗？
    （副歌）草坪上翻滚起大蠼螋，
            天下未见的巨型地蚕。

    窒息克勒斯！颤抖士比亚！伪但丁！无名摩西！

接着我们组织自由贸易盖尔军乐队与群众集会，
用草皮深埋这斯堪的纳维亚老流氓。
我们把这恶徒深埋在牛人镇下，
与魔鬼同列，同丹麦人作伴，
    （副歌）伴着又聋又哑的丹麦人，
            以及他们遗留的全数骨骸。

国王所有的军马，以及所有的部下，
谁也无法复活他那具腐尸；
因为无论在康诺特还是地狱，全无半句真咒，
    （重唱）能教该隐死而复生。
segments.translation:
难怪本地小伙管他叫「赫骗·哎瑞旺」，
钦普登当初一登场，
    （合唱）带着他的投机行，
            开在下段捡便宜街上。

他舒舒服服住在豪华旅店里，
破烂、伎俩、假排场，咱转眼就烧光。
等不了多久，克兰西警长就要清算他的无限公司，
法警在门上敲一声砰，
    （合唱）乒乒乓乓敲门响。
            他再也混不上。

好一声甜倒霉，送给冲上咱岛的浪，
也送给那锤牢维京人的钩帆船。
外邦佬咒那一天，埃布拉纳湾
望见他那黑棕军舰。
    （合唱）望见他那军舰，
            就在港口浅滩。

打哪儿来？普尔贝格吼。煮半便士根！他嚷，施——
               ［给我几个小钱，老婆孩子哭成团。
芬加尔·麦克·奥斯卡·奥内辛·驳船屁股·博尼法斯，
托克斯·明·老洞，这是我挪威踢客的名号，
奥格阿斯艾尔阿特，老娼洞里的挪威踢客老鳕鱼。
    （合唱）一头挪威老骆驼，一条老鳕鱼。
            可不是嘛，老天爷。
扬起来，霍斯蒂，扬起来，你这魔鬼！歌谣唱起来，押韵的歌谣！

那是在淡水花园抽水那会儿，
或照《护理镜报》说的，正在赏猴那会儿，
咱那重量级异教佬汉弗啊莱，
壮胆向姑娘求爱来。
    （合唱）呜呼，她该怎么办！
            女将军输了她的闺门滑铁卢！

他真该羞红脸，那草头老哲人，
哪里能这么直往人家身上挤。
老天爷，他就是这份名录里最难解的谜，
这洪水前的动物园里，
    （合唱）啄嘴先生和咕咕先生。
            诺亚淘气雀，好得跟新的一样。

他在威林顿碑边颠颠簸簸，
咱这旋转出名的河河马，
不知哪个混蛋撂下公共马车的后踏板，
害他染上燧发枪兵，一命呜呼，
    （合唱）欠租没补，后裤也裂。
            判他六年！

好可怜，他那无辜苦命的孩子，
当心那位明媒正娶的太太！
那妇虎一把揪住老埃尔威克，
草地上岂不要闹起蠼螋来？
    （合唱）草地上的大蠼螋，
            你平生没见过这么大！

窒息克勒斯！掷枪士比亚！伪但丁！无名摩西！

接着咱请自由贸易盖尔乐队，召个群众大会，
好给斯堪的纳维诈的勇儿子盖草皮。
咱要把他埋进牛人镇，
跟魔鬼、丹人埋在一起，
    （合唱）跟又聋又哑的丹人，
            连同那些遗骨。
纵有国王手下所有的人、所有的马，
也休想叫他的尸身再起来，
康诺特也好，地狱也好，哪儿都没有真咒，
    （再唱）能唤起一个该隐。

notes.lemma: He'll Cheat E'erawan
notes.text: 三个词首字母仍是 H.C.E.，与前文民众所喊 Here Comes Everybody 相反相成。按声音可听出「他会骗每个人」，正文另造名号，留这层意思在注里。后两节说清算将要发生，沿歌谣口吻。

notes.lemma: Where from? roars Poolbeg. Cookingha'pence, he bawls Donnez- [moi scampitle, wick an wipin'fampiny
notes.text: 问从哪儿来，答话却将变形地名、零钱和法语式讨钱话揉在一起。第46页在 Donnez- 后折行，下一行带左方括号；现译在「施」后照样折开。各地名所指及多语原形仍待核。

notes.lemma: It was during some fresh water garden pumping Or, according to the Nursing Mirror, while admiring the monkeys That our heavyweight heathen Humpharey Made bold a maid to woo (Chorus) Woohoo, what'll she doo! The general lost her maidenloo!
notes.text: 歌谣传述公园求欢的两种说法（花园抽水或照《护士镜报》所说观赏猴子）；副歌 maidenloo 将少女贞操（maidenhead）、滑铁卢（Waterloo）与便所（loo）拼合。

notes.lemma: He ought to blush for himself, the old hayheaded philosopher, For to go and shove himself that way on top of her. Begob, he's the crux of the catalogue Of our antediluvial zoo, (Chorus) Messrs. Billing and Coo. Noah's larks, good as noo.
notes.text: antediluvial zoo 指大洪水前动物园，副歌 Noah's larks 将诺亚方舟（Noah's ark）改写为胡闹嬉戏（larks），Messrs. Billing and Coo 借鸽子交颈咕咕叫（bill and coo）戏拟商号名称。

notes.lemma: With his rent in his rears. Give him six years.
notes.text: rent 可指裂口或租金，rears 可兼听后身与 arrears。译文并写欠租和裤后破裂。六年是合唱喊出的刑罚，并无叙述者另报宣判。

notes.lemma: When that frew gets a grip of old Earwicker Won't there be earwigs on the green? (Chorus) Big earwigs on the green, The largest ever you seen.
notes.text: frew 拼合德语妻子（Frau）与泼妇（shrew）；earwigs on the green 将爱尔兰俗语“wigs on the green”（草坪上假发乱飞，指大打出手）改写为“草坪上爬满蠼螋”。

notes.lemma: Suffoclose! Shikespower! Seudodanto! Anonymoses!
notes.text: 四个感叹词分别变形自索福克勒斯（Sophocles + suffocate / close）、莎士比亚（Shakespeare + shite /ikes / power）、但丁（Dante + pseudo）与摩西（Moses + anonymous）。

notes.lemma: Then we'll have a free trade Gaels' band and mass meeting For to sod the brave son of Scandiknavery. And we'll bury him down in Oxmanstown Along with the devil and Danes
notes.text: Scandiknavery 拼合斯堪的纳维亚（Scandinavia）与无赖行径（knavery）；Oxmanstown（源自 Ostmanstown“东人／维京人镇”）为都柏林利菲河北岸街区，毗邻凤凰公园。

notes.lemma: And not all the king's men nor his horses Will resurrect his corpus
notes.text: Grover 编《鹅妈妈》页79的亨普蒂童谣写国王的马与人无法把他拼回去。此曲一开头便唱亨普蒂，章末反转人、马的次序，又从拼合改成复活尸身。末行 raise a Cain 还可听出闹事，也可近听 cane，译名先留该隐。

source_text.html:
----- 30 -----

 

 

 

 

Now (to forebare for ever solittle of Iris Trees and Lili O'Rangans),
concerning the genesis of Harold or Humphrey Chimpden's
occupational agnomen (we are back in the presurnames
prodromarith period, of course just when enos chalked halltraps)
and discarding once for all those theories from older sources which
would link him back with such pivotal ancestors as the Glues, the
Gravys, the Northeasts, the Ankers and the Earwickers of Sidlesham
in the Hundred of Manhood or proclaim him offsprout of
vikings who had founded wapentake and seddled hem in Herrick
or Eric, the best authenticated version, the Dumlat, read the
Reading of Hofed-ben-Edar, has it that it was this way. We are
told how in the beginning it came to pass that like cabbaging
Cincinnatus the grand old gardener was saving daylight under his
redwoodtree one sultry sabbath afternoon, Hag Chivychas Eve,
in prefall paradise peace by following his plough for rootles in the
rere garden of mobhouse, ye olde marine hotel, when royalty was
announced by runner to have been pleased to have halted itself on
the highroad along which a leisureloving dogfox had cast followed,
also at walking pace, by a lady pack of cocker spaniels. Forgetful
of all save his vassal's plain fealty to the ethnarch Humphrey
or Harold stayed not to yoke or saddle but stumbled out hotface
as he was (his sweatful bandanna loose from his pocketcoat) hasting
to the forecourts of his public in topee, surcingle, solascarf and
plaid, plus fours, puttees and bulldog boots ruddled cinnabar with

----- 31 -----

flagrant marl, jingling his turnpike keys and bearing aloft amid
the fixed pikes of the hunting party a high perch atop of which a
flowerpot was fixed earthside hoist with care. On his majesty, who
was, or often feigned to be, noticeably longsighted from green
youth and had been meaning to inquire what, in effect, had caused
yon causeway to be thus potholed, asking substitutionally to be
put wise as to whether paternoster and silver doctors were not
now more fancied bait for lobstertrapping honest blunt Haromphreyld
answered in no uncertain tones very similarly with a fearless
forehead: Naw, yer maggers, aw war jist a cotchin on thon
bluggy earwuggers. Our sailor king, who was draining a gugglet
of obvious adamale, gift both and gorban, upon this, ceasing to
swallow, smiled most heartily beneath his walrus moustaches and
indulging that none too genial humour which William the Conk
on the spindle side had inherited with the hereditary whitelock
and some shortfingeredness from his greataunt Sophy, turned towards
two of his retinue of gallowglasses, Michael, etheling lord
of Leix and Offaly and the jubilee mayor of Drogheda, Elcock,
(the two scatterguns being Michael M. Manning, protosyndic of
Waterford and an Italian excellency named Giubilei according to
a later version cited by the learned scholarch Canavan of Canmakenoise),
in either case a triptychal religious family symbolising
puritas of doctrina, business per usuals and the purchypatch of
hamlock where the paddish preties grow and remarked dilsydulsily:
Holybones of Saint Hubert how our red brother of Pouringrainia
would audibly fume did he know that we have for surtrusty
bailiwick a turnpiker who is by turns a pikebailer no seldomer
than an earwigger! For he kinned Jom Pill with his court
so gray and his haunts in his house in the mourning. (One still
hears that pebble crusted laughta, japijap cheerycherrily, among
the roadside tree the lady Holmpatrick planted and still one feels
the amossive silence of the cladstone allegibelling: Ive mies outs
ide Bourn.) Comes the question are these the facts of his nom-
inigentilisation as recorded and accolated in both or either of the
collateral andrewpaulmurphyc narratives. Are those their fata
which we read in sibylline between the fas and its nefas? No dung

----- 32 -----

on the road? And shall Nohomiah be our place like? Yea, Mulachy
our kingable khan? We shall perhaps not so soon see. Pinck
poncks that bail for seeks alicence where cumsceptres with scentaurs
